jobs.title: Territory Sales Manager 80 – 100%
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our team as a Territory Sales Manager and drive the growth of our High Voltage Bushings and On-Load Tap-Changers business across the Brazilian market. Leveraging your strong network and market knowledge, you will help expand our presence with transformer manufacturers, utilities, EPC companies, and industrial customers while representing products manufactured in our Swiss and Swedish factories.

This role offers the opportunity to combine your technical understanding of the power industry with your commercial expertise in one of the world's most dynamic energy markets. Working closely with customers and internal experts, you will contribute to strategic business development initiatives, identify new opportunities, and build long-term customer partnerships that support the energy transition.

The role is based in Altstetten, Zurich, Switzerland, and involves approximately 20–30% travel.

How you'll make an impact

• Develop and grow business opportunities for High Voltage Bushings and On-Load Tap-Changers across the Brazilian market
• Build and strengthen relationships with transformer manufacturers, utilities, EPC contractors, and industrial customers
• Identify market trends, customer needs, and emerging opportunities to support long-term business growth
• Lead commercial discussions and support negotiations with key customers and stakeholders
• Collaborate with Offer Engineering and Tendering teams to develop competitive technical and commercial solutions
• Prepare and review proposals based on customer requirements and market expectations
• Maintain an accurate sales pipeline and contribute to forecasting activities
• Ensure smooth handover of secured orders to project management and execution teams
Your background

• Minimum 10 years of experience in sales, business development, engineering, or a similar customer-facing role within the energy, electrical, transformer, or industrial sector
• Strong knowledge of the Brazilian power and energy market, including utilities, transformer manufacturers, and key industry stakeholders
• Proven track record of developing customer relationships and driving business growth in Brazil
• Technical background in electrical or mechanical engineering or equivalent industry experience
• Experience working in international and multicultural business environments
• Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
• Business fluent in English and Portuguese, Spanish is an asset
• Self-driven, relationship-oriented, and able to work independently while collaborating effectively with global teams
More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Unisciti al nostro team come Territory Sales Manager e spingi la crescita del nostro business High Tensione Bushings e On-Load Tap-Changers sul mercato brasiliano. Grazie alla sua forte conoscenza della rete e del mercato, contribuirai ad espandere la nostra presenza con produttori di trasformatori, utility, aziende di PCC e clienti industriali, rappresentando prodotti fabbricati nelle nostre fabbriche svizzere e svedesi.

Questo ruolo offre l'opportunità di combinare la vostra comprensione tecnica dell'industria del potere con la vostra competenza commerciale in uno dei mercati energetici più dinamici del mondo. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i clienti e gli esperti interni, contribuirai a iniziative strategiche di sviluppo aziendale, identificare nuove opportunità e costruire partnership con clienti a lungo termine che supportino la transizione energetica.

Il ruolo ha sede a Altstetten, Zurigo, Svizzera, e coinvolge circa il 20-30% di viaggio.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Sviluppare e coltivare opportunità di business per boccole ad alta tensione e Tap-Changer On-Load in tutto il mercato brasiliano
• Costruire e rafforzare le relazioni con i produttori di trasformatori, le utility, gli appaltatori EPC e i clienti industriali
• Identificare le tendenze del mercato, le esigenze dei clienti e le opportunità emergenti per sostenere la crescita del business a lungo termine
• Condurre discussioni commerciali e sostenere i negoziati con i principali clienti e stakeholder
• Collabora con i team di Offer Engineering e Tendering per sviluppare soluzioni tecniche e commerciali competitive
• Preparare e rivedere le proposte in base alle esigenze del cliente e alle aspettative di mercato
• Mantenere una pipeline di vendita accurata e contribuire alle attività di previsione
• Assicurare una consegna regolare di ordini garantiti ai team di gestione e esecuzione del progetto
Il tuo sfondo

• Minimo 10 anni di esperienza nelle vendite, nello sviluppo aziendale, nell'ingegneria o in un simile ruolo di customer-facing nel settore energetico, elettrico, trasformatore o industriale
• Forte conoscenza del mercato brasiliano dell'energia e dell'energia, tra cui utilità, produttori di trasformatori e principali stakeholder del settore
• Provato track record di sviluppo delle relazioni con i clienti e la crescita del business in Brasile
• Sfondo tecnico in ingegneria elettrica o meccanica o esperienza industriale equivalente
• Esperienza di lavoro in ambienti aziendali internazionali e multiculturali
• Forte capacità di comunicazione, negoziazione e gestione degli stakeholder
• Business fluent in inglese e portoghese, lo spagnolo è un bene
• Autodidatta, orientata alle relazioni e in grado di lavorare in modo indipendente, collaborando efficacemente con i team globali
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Sales and Operations Planning Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about shaping business performance through strategic planning and cross-functional collaboration? Join Hitachi Energy and take a leading role in driving our global Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process. In this highly visible position, you will work closely with senior leaders and stakeholders across the organization to ensure alignment between market demand, operational capabilities, and business objectives. If you thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are motivated to make a measurable impact, we would love to hear from you.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead and continuously improve Hitachi Energy's local Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives

• Facilitate monthly S&OP reviews and executive meetings, providing insights, reports, and recommendations to support decision-making

• Collaborate with Sales, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, and Product Management to drive alignment, resolve conflicts, and build consensus

• Develop demand planning and forecasting methodologies for a broad portfolio of critical products, leveraging market intelligence and data analytics

• Monitor key performance indicators such as forecast accuracy, service levels, inventory performance, and production adherence to drive business improvements

• Lead and support strategic initiatives, representing the planning organization in cross-functional and continuous improvement programs

• Drive process optimization through digital solutions, analytics, and best practices to enhance planning excellence

• Present executive-level analyses and recommendations while mentoring team members and fostering a culture of collaboration and accountability

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field; Master's degree is an advantage . APICS CPIM or CSCP certification is an advantage;

• Significant experience in Supply Chain, Operations, Planning, or S&OP within an international manufacturing environment

• Advanced SAP knowledge; experience with intercompany purchasing and planning is highly desirable

• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and translate insights into business decisions

• Proven ability to work independently, manage a high workload, solve complex problems, and navigate ambiguity in a dynamic environment

• Strong communication, presentation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior management and cross-functional teams

• GIS products and business structure knowledge is beneficial

• Highly motivated, precise, and proactive professional with a continuous improvement mindset;

• Business fluent in English, German is beneficial

Why you'll succeed

You are a precise and analytical professional who enjoys solving complex challenges and turning data into business value. You combine strong planning expertise with excellent stakeholder management skills and can confidently engage with senior leaders. Your independent working style, resilience, and motivation enable you to deliver results in a fast-paced environment while driving continuous improvement and collaboration across the organization.

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

• Analizzazioni e raccomandazioni a livello esecutivo attuali, mentre mentoring membri del team e promuovere una cultura di collaborazione e responsabilità

• Professionista altamente motivato, preciso e proattivo con una mentalità di miglioramento continuo;

• Business fluent in inglese, tedesco è vantaggioso

Sei un professionista preciso e analitico che ama risolvere complesse sfide e trasformare i dati in valore aziendale. jobs.title: Internship in Mechanical and System Simulations for High Voltage Circuit Breakers 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join an innovative and collaborative engineering team shaping the future of high-voltage technology. You will contribute to the development of next-generation SF6-free circuit breakers in a supportive and knowledge-sharing environment. This role offers hands-on experience with simulations, measurements, and cutting-edge engineering tools. You will learn from experienced mentors while taking ownership of meaningful tasks. The position supports continuous learning, curiosity, and professional growth. Duration of the internship is 9-12 months.

How you'll make an impact

• Support development of SF6-free high-voltage circuit breakers through simulations

• Perform system simulations of circuit breakers to support design decisions

• Pre and post processing of simulations models and results

• Test data analysis and preparation of the simulation input files

• Use and further develop internally established simulation tools

• Collaborating with interdisciplinary project teams in circuit breaker development

Your background

• Enrolled Student (preferably Master) or Graduate in Physics, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related field

• Basic knowledge of simulations associated with mechanical and electrical engineering applications

• Knowledge of mechanics and material strength (practical skills in ABAQUS or similar finite element code is advantageous)

• Knowledge and practical skills of Modelica language and Dymola are advantageous

• Strong programming skills and interest in Python

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Ability to work collaboratively and take initiative independently

More about us

We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.
We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

jobs.title: R&D Design Engineer - Insulation and Components Global Product Care
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is seeking a Design Engineer for the Business Unit Transformers to join our innovative and forward-thinking Global Product Care team for Insulation and Components. You will play a crucial role in the development and design of innovative products and systems that meet our customer needs and industry standards. You will collaborate with cross functional teams and factories globally to ensure project specifications are met while adhering to industry standards and design best practices. Your expertise in engineering principles and practices will contribute to optimize designs for performance, functionality, and sustainability.

How you will make an impact

• You will establish mechanical simulation models for transformer components such as bushings, tap-changers and measurement devices, conduct static/dynamic mechanics, model, seismic, short-circuit impact and thermal-structure coupling simulation analysis.
• You will conduct mechanical performance verification in accordance with IEC, IEEE, GB and other international & domestic standards, issue professional simulation reports, provide technical support for product R&D, type test and mass production.
• You will continue to develop internal tools for mechanical evaluations, participate in industrial technical exchanges. Support factories troubleshooting in your domain of expertise and collaborate with global team on evaluation of new R&D solution.
• You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
• Collaborate with the supply chain team to ensure designs are manufacturable and cost-effective, selecting optimal materials and components.
• Evaluate and select appropriate materials and manufacturing processes.
• Conduct thorough design reviews and verifications, implementing modifications to elevate project quality.
• Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues
• Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team
Your background

• Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
• Minimum 3 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components
• Solid mechanical knowledge, ideally in the field of electrical insulators or high-voltage components
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
• Should have good understanding of IEC /IEEE/ISO/ASTM Standards.
• Experience in the finite element analysis and in the use of the ANSYS software
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to speak with and work together with the technical teams in different parts of the world.
• Proactive attitude, self-motivated and with a strong sense of ownership.
• Open to change, feedback and continuous improvement.
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:

• Private medical care and life insurance​

• Access to fitness and wellness programs​

• Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks​

• Employee Capital Plans (PPK)​

• Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home​

• Spectacles and contact lenses allowance​

• Company events and team‑building activities​

• Psychological support program​

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Hitachi Energy è alla ricerca di un Ingegnere di Design per i Trasformatori di Business Unit per unire il nostro team di assistenza globale per l'isolamento e i componenti. Si svolgerà un ruolo cruciale nello sviluppo e nella progettazione di prodotti e sistemi innovativi che soddisfano le nostre esigenze dei clienti e gli standard del settore. Collaborerai con team funzionali e fabbriche cross a livello globale per garantire che le specifiche del progetto vengano soddisfatte rispettando gli standard del settore e le migliori pratiche di progettazione. La vostra esperienza nei principi e nelle pratiche ingegneristiche contribuirà ad ottimizzare i progetti per prestazioni, funzionalità e sostenibilità.

Come si farà un impatto

• Istituirai modelli di simulazione meccanica per i componenti del trasformatore come boccole, scambiatori di rubinetti e dispositivi di misura, conduci meccanica statica/dinamica, modello, impatto sismico, cortocircuito e analisi di simulazione di accoppiamento termico-struttura.
• Condurrà la verifica delle prestazioni meccaniche in conformità con IEC, IEEE, GB e altri standard internazionali e nazionali, emettere rapporti di simulazione professionale, fornire supporto tecnico per il prodotto R&D, test di tipo e produzione di massa.
• Continuerai a sviluppare strumenti interni per le valutazioni meccaniche, partecipare a scambi tecnici industriali. Supporta i problemi delle fabbriche nel tuo dominio di competenze e collabora con il team globale per la valutazione della nuova soluzione R&D.
• L'utente sarà responsabile per garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili.
• Collabora con il team della supply chain per garantire che i progetti siano manufacturable e convenienti, selezionando materiali e componenti ottimali.
• Valuta e seleziona materiali e processi produttivi appropriati.
• Condurre approfondite recensioni e verifiche di progettazione, implementando modifiche per elevare la qualità del progetto.
• Prendere le responsabilità della leadership del progetto o svolgere un ruolo chiave all'interno di team di progetto, mentre sostenere e mentoring colleghi junior
• Agire come esperto di materia, sostenere i colleghi e condividere le conoscenze per promuovere la collaborazione e l'innovazione all'interno del team
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Fisica, o un campo correlato
• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza in R&D o ingegneria, preferibilmente in attrezzature o componenti ad alta tensione
• Solida conoscenza meccanica, idealmente nel campo degli isolatori elettrici o componenti ad alta tensione
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione in inglese, scritto e parlato
• Dovrebbe avere una buona comprensione degli standard IEC /IEEE/ISO/ASTM.
• Esperienza nell'analisi degli elementi finiti e nell'uso del software ANSYS
• Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze.
• Capacità di parlare e lavorare insieme con i team tecnici in diverse parti del mondo.
• Atteggiamento attivo, auto-motivato e con un forte senso di proprietà.
• Aperto a cambiamento, feedback e miglioramento continuo.
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

A Hitachi Energy, riconosciamo che il nostro popolo è al centro del nostro successo. Ci impegniamo a fornire un lavoro di supporto e inclusivo, premi competitivi e opportunità di crescita professionale e personale. Il nostro pacchetto benefici è progettato per aiutare i dipendenti a prosperare sia al lavoro che nella loro vita personale.

I nostri vantaggi offerti per questo ruolo includono generalmente:

• Assistenza medica privata e assicurazione sulla vita

• Accesso ai programmi di fitness e benessere

• Accesso ai vantaggi piattaforma con sconti e vantaggi

• Piani di capitale dei dipendenti (PPK)

• Attrezzature per lavorare da casa o assegni per la creazione di un posto di lavoro a casa

• Spettacoli e indennità di lenti a contatto

• Eventi aziendali e attività di team building

• Programma di supporto psicologico

Ihre Expertise in technischen Prinzipien und Praktiken wird dazu beitragen, Designs für Leistung, Funktionalität und Nachhaltigkeit zu optimieren.

• Feste mechanische Kenntnisse, idealerweise im Bereich elektrischer Isolatoren oder Hochspannungskomponenten

• Hervorragende analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten.

L'opportunité

Hitachi Energy est à la recherche d'un ingénieur de conception pour les transformateurs de l'unité d'affaires pour rejoindre notre équipe innovante et avant-gardiste Global Product Care pour l'isolation et les composants. Vous jouerez un rôle crucial dans le développement et la conception de produits et systèmes innovants qui répondent aux besoins de nos clients et aux normes de l'industrie. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes et des usines interfonctionnelles dans le monde entier pour vous assurer que les spécifications du projet sont respectées tout en respectant les normes de l'industrie et les meilleures pratiques de conception. Votre expertise en principes et pratiques d'ingénierie contribuera à optimiser les conceptions pour la performance, la fonctionnalité et la durabilité.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Vous établirez des modèles de simulation mécanique pour les composants des transformateurs tels que les douilles, les changeurs de robinets et les appareils de mesure, effectuerez des analyses de simulation de couplage statique/dynamique, de modèle, sismique, de court-circuit et de structure thermique.
• Vous effectuerez la vérification de la performance mécanique conformément à la CEI, à l'IEEE, au GB et à d'autres normes internationales et nationales, publierez des rapports de simulation professionnelle, fournirez un soutien technique pour la R-D des produits, l'essai de type et la production de masse.
• Vous continuerez à développer des outils internes pour les évaluations mécaniques, participerez aux échanges techniques industriels. Soutenir le dépannage des usines dans votre domaine d'expertise et collaborer avec l'équipe mondiale sur l'évaluation de la nouvelle solution de R-D.
• Vous serez responsable de la conformité aux règlements, procédures et lignes directrices externes et internes applicables.
• Collaborer avec l'équipe de la chaîne d'approvisionnement pour s'assurer que les designs sont fabriqués et rentables, en choisissant des matériaux et des composants optimaux.
• Évaluer et sélectionner les matériaux et procédés de fabrication appropriés.
• Effectuer des examens et des vérifications approfondis de la conception, en apportant des modifications pour améliorer la qualité des projets.
• Assumer des responsabilités en matière de leadership de projet ou jouer un rôle clé au sein des équipes de projet, tout en soutenant et en mentorant des collègues subalternes
• Agir en tant qu'expert en la matière, appuyer les collègues et partager les connaissances pour favoriser la collaboration et l'innovation au sein de l'équipe

• Connaissance mécanique solide, idéalement dans le domaine des isolateurs électriques ou des composants haute tension
• Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, à la fois écrite et parlée

• Excellente capacité d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
• Capacité de parler et de travailler avec les équipes techniques dans différentes parties du monde.

jobs.description:
The opportunity

At Hitachi Energy, you'll have the opportunity to lead complex and meaningful GIS projects that support the energy transition around the world. As a Project Manager, you will work with diverse international teams, customers, and stakeholders to deliver innovative solutions that make a real impact.

We are looking for a collaborative and proactive leader who enjoys bringing people together, solving challenges, and driving successful project outcomes. Whether your experience comes from GIS, substations, power infrastructure, or a related industrial environment, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives, leadership potential, and a growth mindset just as much as specific industry experience.

How you'll make an impact

• Lead complex international projects throughout the entire project lifecycle, from project handover through engineering, manufacturing, installation, commissioning, and final delivery

• Take ownership of project execution, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards

• Build trusted partnerships with customers and serve as their primary point of contact throughout project delivery

• Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, supply chain, and service functions worldwide

• Foster strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive alignment and project success

• Proactively identify risks, opportunities, and improvement initiatives while guiding the team through challenges and change

• Manage commercial aspects of projects, including contracts, claims, forecasting, and financial performance

• Support continuous improvement efforts and contribute to knowledge sharing, mentoring, and the development of project management excellence within the organization

Your background

• Master's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field

• Several years of experience driving complex international projects in a global industrial environment

• Experience within GIS, substations, power transmission, energy infrastructure, or similar industries is highly valued

• Being able to drive project delivery, stakeholder management, and customer engagement

• Business and financial acumen with experience managing budgets, schedules, risks, and contracts

• Ability to lead cross-functional teams and successfully navigate complex, multicultural project environments

• Project Management certification (PMP, IPMA, or equivalent) is an advantage but not essential

• Fluent in English, additional languages such as French, Italian or German are a plus

• An organized, resilient, and solution-oriented mindset with a passion for collaboration and delivering value to customers

We know that no candidate meets every qualification listed above. If you're excited about this opportunity and believe your experience can contribute to our success, we encourage you to apply. We welcome diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

A Hitachi Energy, avrai l'opportunità di condurre progetti GIS complessi e significativi che supportano la transizione energetica in tutto il mondo. Come Project Manager, lavorerai con diversi team internazionali, clienti e stakeholder per offrire soluzioni innovative che abbiano un impatto reale.

Il tuo sfondo

• L'esperienza all'interno di GIS, sottostazioni, trasmissione di energia, infrastrutture energetiche o industrie simili è altamente apprezzata

• Affari e acume finanziario con la gestione di esperienze di budget, programmi, rischi e contratti

• Capacità di guidare team interfunzionali e navigare con successo in ambienti di progetto complessi e multiculturali

• La certificazione Project Management (PMP, IPMA o equivalente) è un vantaggio ma non essenziale

• Fluente in inglese, lingue aggiuntive come francese, italiano o tedesco sono un plus

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Bei Hitachi Energy haben Sie die Möglichkeit, komplexe und sinnvolle GIS-Projekte zu leiten, die die Energiewende auf der ganzen Welt unterstützen. Als Projektmanager arbeiten Sie mit verschiedenen internationalen Teams, Kunden und Stakeholdern zusammen, um innovative Lösungen zu liefern, die eine echte Wirkung erzielen.

Wir suchen eine kollaborative und proaktive Führungskraft, die es genießt, Menschen zusammenzubringen, Herausforderungen zu lösen und erfolgreiche Projektergebnisse voranzutreiben. Ob Ihre Erfahrung aus GIS, Umspannwerken, Strominfrastruktur oder einer verwandten industriellen Umgebung stammt, wir empfehlen Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wir schätzen vielfältige Perspektiven, Führungspotenziale und eine Wachstumsmentalität ebenso wie spezifische Branchenerfahrung.

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Führen Sie komplexe internationale Projekte während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus, von der Projektübergabe über Engineering, Fertigung, Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Endlieferung

• Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Projektausführung und stellen Sie sicher, dass Projekte sicher, pünktlich, innerhalb des Budgets und nach höchsten Qualitätsstandards geliefert werden

• Bauen Sie vertrauenswürdige Partnerschaften mit Kunden auf und dienen Sie als primärer Ansprechpartner während der gesamten Projektabwicklung

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit multidisziplinären Teams in den Bereichen Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain und Service weltweit

• Pflegen Sie starke Beziehungen zu internen und externen Stakeholdern, um die Ausrichtung und den Projekterfolg zu fördern

• Identifizieren Sie proaktiv Risiken, Chancen und Verbesserungsinitiativen und führen Sie das Team durch Herausforderungen und Veränderungen

• Verwalten Sie kommerzielle Aspekte von Projekten, einschließlich Verträgen, Ansprüchen, Prognosen und finanzieller Leistung

• Unterstützung kontinuierlicher Verbesserungsbemühungen und Beitrag zum Wissensaustausch, Mentoring und zur Entwicklung von Projektmanagement-Exzellenz innerhalb der Organisation

Dein Hintergrund

• Master-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung bei der Umsetzung komplexer internationaler Projekte in einem globalen industriellen Umfeld

• Erfahrung in GIS, Umspannwerken, Energieübertragung, Energieinfrastruktur oder ähnlichen Branchen wird hoch geschätzt

• In der Lage sein, die Projektabwicklung, das Stakeholder-Management und die Kundenbindung voranzutreiben

• Geschäfts- und Finanzsinn mit Erfahrung im Management von Budgets, Zeitplänen, Risiken und Verträgen

• Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams zu leiten und erfolgreich in komplexen, multikulturellen Projektumgebungen zu navigieren

• Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (PMP, IPMA oder gleichwertig) ist ein Vorteil, aber nicht unerlässlich

• fließend Englisch, zusätzliche Sprachen wie Französisch, Italienisch oder Deutsch sind ein Plus

• Eine organisierte, belastbare und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit einer Leidenschaft für die Zusammenarbeit und die Bereitstellung von Mehrwert für Kunden

Wir wissen, dass kein Kandidat alle oben aufgeführten Qualifikationen erfüllt. Wenn Sie von dieser Gelegenheit begeistert sind und glauben, dass Ihre Erfahrung zu unserem Erfolg beitragen kann, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wir begrüßen unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Erfahrungen und setzen uns dafür ein, einen integrativen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen, an dem jeder gedeihen kann.

Mehr über uns

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is a global leader in power and renewable technologies that enable utility and industry customers to improve their performance while lowering environmental impact. CHSEM provides high‑power semiconductor devices to Hitachi Energy internal customers (e.g. HVDC, GPQSS) as well as to external customers.
The Senior Material Quality Engineer ensures the quality, robustness, and long‑term reliability of critical raw materials used in BiMOS semiconductor device production at the Lenzburg fabrication facility. Acting as a technical authority, the role independently manages complex material‑ and supplier‑related quality topics, contributes to supplier quality strategy, and supports both supplier and team capability development to enable stable and scalable operations.

How you'll make an impact

• Drive the material quality approach for critical raw materials used in BiMOS operations

• Define and continuously improve CTQ concepts and control strategies

• Lead complex material quality investigations related to deviations, yield, and reliability issues

• Monitor & develop supplier performance and ensure effective implementation of corrective actions

• Lead material qualification, requalification, and change management activities

• Support production with technical expertise during production, troubleshooting, and ramp-up phases

• Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives to enhance quality, reliability, and cost efficiency

• Act as a technical reference, supporting or mentoring engineers and strengthening supplier and team capabilities

Your background

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, or a related field

• Minimum 5 years of experience in material quality, supplier quality, or semiconductor manufacturing

• Certified auditor (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, or equivalent)

• Strong knowledge of material quality, process control, and risk management in a manufacturing environment

• Proven ability to independently manage complex material and supplier quality issues

• Experience with structured quality methods such as 8D, Six Sigma, or equivalent

More about us

We offer you:

• Extra days off between Christmas and New Year

• Subsidised meals at the locations with canteens

• 50% discount on main courses at our FELFEL fridges

• Discount on memberships at various fitness centres

• Discounts on various products and services

• Attractive pension benefits with our company pension fund

• Diversity: Promotion of diversity and inclusion and cultural offers, credit cards, petrol, etc.)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Hitachi Energy è leader globale nelle tecnologie energetiche e rinnovabili che permettono ai clienti di utilità e industria di migliorare le loro prestazioni riducendo al contempo l'impatto ambientale. CHSEM fornisce dispositivi semiconduttori ad alta potenza ai clienti interni Hitachi Energy (ad esempio HVDC, GPQSS) e ai clienti esterni.
L'Ingegnere di Qualità del Materiale Senior garantisce la qualità, la robustezza e l'affidabilità a lungo termine delle materie prime critiche utilizzate nella produzione di dispositivi semiconduttori BiMOS presso la struttura di fabbricazione di Lenzburg. Essendo un'autorità tecnica, il ruolo gestisce in modo indipendente complessi argomenti di qualità legati ai materiali e ai fornitori, contribuisce alla strategia di qualità dei fornitori e supporta sia lo sviluppo delle capacità dei fornitori che del team per consentire operazioni stabili e scalabili.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Guidare l'approccio di qualità del materiale per le materie prime critiche utilizzate nelle operazioni di BiMOS

• Definire e migliorare continuamente i concetti e le strategie di controllo CTQ

• Indagini complesse sulla qualità dei materiali relative alle deviazioni, alla resa e ai problemi di affidabilità

• Monitorare e sviluppare le prestazioni dei fornitori e garantire un'efficace attuazione delle azioni correttive

• Leader delle attività di qualificazione, riqualificazione e gestione dei cambiamenti

• Supporta la produzione con competenze tecniche durante la produzione, la risoluzione dei problemi e le fasi di rampa

• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento multifunzionale per migliorare la qualità, l'affidabilità e l'efficienza dei costi

• Agire come riferimento tecnico, supporto o mentoring ingegneri e rafforzare le capacità di fornitore e team

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea o Master in Scienze dei materiali, Chimica, Fisica, o un campo correlato

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nella qualità dei materiali, nella qualità dei fornitori o nella produzione di semiconduttori

• Revisore certificato (VDA 6.3, ISO 19011, o equivalente)

• Forte conoscenza della qualità dei materiali, del controllo dei processi e della gestione dei rischi in un ambiente di produzione

• Prova capacità di gestire in modo indipendente i problemi complessi di materiali e qualità dei fornitori

• Esperienza con metodi di qualità strutturati come 8D, Six Sigma, o equivalente

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Vi offriamo:

• Giorni extra tra Natale e Capodanno

• Pasti sottosidrati nelle località con mense

• 50% di sconto sui corsi principali presso i nostri frigoriferi FELFEL

• Sconto sui soci presso vari centri fitness

• Sconti su vari prodotti e servizi

• Prestazioni pensionistiche interessanti con il nostro fondo pensione aziendale

• Diversità: Promozione della diversità e inclusione e offerte culturali, carte di credito, benzina, ecc.)

jobs.title: GCB Tendering Manager (80–100%) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
We are looking for a highly motivated GCB Tendering Manager to join our dynamic team at Hitachi Energy Ltd.

In your role, you drive customer success and maintenance business growth by delivering tailored service solutions for high‑voltage GCB products. You act as a key customer interface, ensuring that customer needs are addressed through reliable, value-driven, and competitive service offerings.

How you´ll make an impact

• Drive the growth of the GCB maintenance and service business by developing tailored service solutions that meet customer needs and maximize long-term asset performance
• Build and maintain strong customer relationships, proactively identifying maintenance opportunities and promoting value-added service offerings across the installed base
• Prepare, coordinate, and follow up on commercial quotations, ensuring competitive, accurate, and profitable offers that are converted into successful orders
• Own and manage the sales pipeline for the assigned markets, maintaining forecast accuracy, driving opportunity progression, and reducing overdue quotations
• Collaborate closely with engineering, supply chain, field service, troubleshooting teams, and local business units to deliver high-quality customer solutions and ensure seamless project handovers
• Support and enable service sales teams, local sales units, and channel partners through product training, commercial guidance, and sharing of best practices
• Act as the primary point of contact for customers, resolving commercial and operational issues in a timely and professional manner while maintaining high customer satisfaction
• Leverage digital tools such as Salesforce, SAP, SOMA, and PowerShop to optimize sales processes, monitor performance metrics, and contribute to continuous improvement and business growth initiatives
Your background

• Technical or business education (apprenticeship, FH/TH, diploma)
• Experience with GCB products and digital sales platforms is an advantage
• Knowledge of sales methodologies, account management, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and analytics
• Good communication and negotiation skills
• Fluent in English; German and other languages are a plus
• Team oriented, structured, and customer focused mindset
More about us

• You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement

• You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities

• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought

• Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all

• Flexible working, including hybrid/remote working opportunities

• A competitive compensation and benefits package

jobs.title: Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as Scientist in AI-Driven Power Electronics

We are looking for a research scientist with expertise in power electronics and power grid applications to join our Research Center in Baden/Switzerland. In an interdisciplinary environment, you will drive cutting-edge innovation and develop new solutions for a wide range of fast-growing applications like HVDC, energy storage systems and renewables like wind or solar. Seize this unique opportunity and join our motivated team to contribute to a sustainable energy future for all!

How you'll make an impact

• You innovate: Transform power electronics modeling, design and optimization by incorporating AI and ML
• You investigate: Perform industrial research in multi-physics modelling and optimization for power electronic systems to create advanced, high-efficiency engineering tools targeting new solutions for power grid applications.
• You take initiative: Collaborate with a global and interdisciplinary team of researchers and engineers across research and business units to identify, shape, and solve impactful industrial challenges
• You collaborate: Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise. Interact with local and global external partners including universities and vendors
• You communicate: Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports
Your background

• PhD in Electrical Engineering specialized in Power Electronics or PhD in Computer Science specialized in AI
• Proven expertise in AI/ML, with a solid understanding of algorithms, frameworks, and extensive experience in Python and relevant software tools
• Ability to apply AI/ML to engineering problems, in particular in the field of power electronics
• Experience in power electronics design and modeling. Know-how in power electronics integration topics such as cooling and mechanical integration, insulation, EMC, and grid integration is considered as a plus
• Excellent communication skills in English, team player attitude, initiative and creativity
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

jobs.title: Photolithography Process Engineer 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today!

How you'll make an impact

• Ensure processes meet the production program and yield goals and address any product yield and rework issues.

• Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line.

• Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects.

• Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC).

• Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line.

• Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production.

• Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay.

• On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers.

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience

• Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing)

• Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis

• Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography

• Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred

• Good English and German language skills

• Ability to work in a cleanroom environment

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Unisciti a un team di fotolitografia ad alte prestazioni in cui la tua esperienza fa davvero un impatto. In qualità di Senior Photolithography Engineer, sarai responsabile dello sviluppo e dell'ottimizzazione dei processi fotolitici utilizzati nella produzione di semiconduttori. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di lavorare con apparecchiature di litografia avanzate, collaborando con team interfunzionali e garantendo standard di produzione di alta qualità. Questa è la vostra opportunità per modellare le decisioni tecniche, contribuire a strategie di utensili a lungo termine, e guidare miglioramenti significativi nella stabilità, uptime e le prestazioni di processo. Sei qualcuno che prende la proprietà, prospera in un ambiente frenetico e gode di un impatto reale? Allora applica oggi!

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Assicurarsi che i processi soddisfino il programma di produzione e gli obiettivi di resa e affrontino eventuali problemi di resa e rielaborazione dei prodotti.

• Impegnarsi con attrezzature e fornitori di materiali per sviluppare nuove soluzioni e migliorare i processi esistenti, per garantire un buon funzionamento della linea di produzione.

• Sviluppare nuove tecniche, modificare i progetti esistenti e coordinare i progetti di miglioramento del processo.

• Analizzare i dati del processo per identificare le tendenze, ottimizzare le prestazioni e risolvere i problemi (implementazione e controllare regolarmente SPC).

• Progettazione indipendente e realizzazione di nuovi macchinari nella linea di produzione.

• Lavorare a stretto contatto con l'integrazione dei processi, l'incisione bagnata, la diffusione, i metalli, l'incisione secca e i team di impianti per garantire la produzione senza soluzione di continuità.

• Supporta alcuni strumenti di metrologia per misurare CD e Overlay.

• I dazi doganali nei fine settimana e nei giorni festivi (come richiesto dalla produzione) con la partecipazione alla riunione on-call (prima dell'obbligo di pagamento) hanno concordato sulla sua responsabilità con gli altri fornitori di servizi on-call.

Il tuo sfondo

• Corso di laurea in un campo correlato (ad esempio, elettrico, meccanico, chimico, scienza dei materiali o fisica) con 5+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o master con 3+ anni di esperienza nell'industria o nel dottorato con esperienza nel settore

• Ampia esperienza nelle operazioni di fotolitografia wafer in particolare nel rivestimento e nell'esposizione in Steppers, in un ambiente di produzione di wafer (produzione di ondulazioni a testa di film, semiconduttore)

• Familiarità con sistemi software di fabbrica di wafer automatizzati come SPC, MES e Experience con estrazione, manipolazione e analisi dei dati

• Forte comprensione dell'ottica e della litografia di immersione

• La competenza nella scienza dei dati e nella programmazione è preferita

• Buone competenze linguistiche in inglese e tedesco

• Capacità di lavorare in un ambiente pulito

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Die Chance

Treten Sie einem leistungsstarken Photolithografie-Team bei, in dem Ihre Expertise wirklich Wirkung zeigt. Als Senior Photolithography Engineer sind Sie für die Entwicklung und Optimierung von Photolithographieprozessen in der Halbleiterfertigung verantwortlich. Ihre Aufgabe besteht darin, mit fortschrittlichen Lithografiegeräten zu arbeiten, mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenzuarbeiten und qualitativ hochwertige Produktionsstandards zu gewährleisten. Dies ist Ihre Chance, technische Entscheidungen zu gestalten, zu langfristigen Werkzeugstrategien beizutragen und sinnvolle Verbesserungen in Bezug auf Stabilität, Verfügbarkeit und Prozessleistung zu erzielen. Sind Sie jemand, der Besitz übernimmt, in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung gedeiht und es genießt, echte Auswirkungen zu erzielen? Heute bewerben!

Wie Sie einen Einfluss machen werden

• Sicherstellen, dass Prozesse das Produktionsprogramm und die Ertragsziele erfüllen und alle Produkterträge und Nacharbeitsprobleme angehen.

• Engagieren Sie sich mit Ausrüstungs- und Materialanbietern, um neue Lösungen zu entwickeln und bestehende Prozesse zu verbessern, um einen reibungslosen Betrieb der Produktionslinie zu gewährleisten.

• Entwickeln Sie neue Techniken, ändern Sie bestehende Designs und koordinieren Sie Prozessverbesserungsprojekte.

• Analysieren Sie Prozessdaten, um Trends zu erkennen, die Leistung zu optimieren und Probleme zu beheben (Implementieren und regelmäßige Überprüfung von SPC).

• Unabhängige Planung und Implementierung neuer Maschinen in die Produktionslinie.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Prozessintegration, Nassätzen, Diffusion, Metallen, Trockenätzen und Implantatteams zusammen, um eine nahtlose Produktion zu gewährleisten.

• Unterstützt einige Metrologie-Tools, z. B. um CD und Overlay zu messen.

• Bereitschaftsdienste an Wochenenden und Feiertagen (wie ab der Produktion erforderlich) mit Teilnahme an der Bereitschaftssitzung (vor dem Bereitschaftsdienst) in eigener Verantwortung mit den anderen Bereitschaftsdienstanbietern vereinbart.

Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem verwandten Bereich (z. B. Elektrik, Mechanik, Chemie, Materialwissenschaften oder Physik) mit 5+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Master-Abschluss mit 3+ Jahren Erfahrung in der Industrie oder Ph.D. mit Branchenerfahrung

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in Wafer-Photolithographie-Operationen, insbesondere in der Beschichtung und Belichtung in Steppers, in einer Wafer-Herstellungsumgebung (Dünnfilmkopf, Halbleiterwafer-Herstellung)

• Vertrautheit mit automatisierten Wafer Factory-Softwaresystemen wie SPC, MES und Erfahrung mit Datenextraktion, -manipulation und -analyse

• Starkes Verständnis von Optik und Immersionslithographie

• Kenntnisse in Data Science und Programmierung werden bevorzugt

• Gute Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse

Rejoignez une équipe de photolithographie de haute performance où votre expertise fait vraiment un impact. En tant qu'ingénieur principal en photolithographie, vous serez responsable du développement et de l'optimisation des processus de photolithographie utilisés dans la fabrication de semi-conducteurs. Votre rôle consistera à travailler avec des équipements de lithographie avancés, à collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et à garantir des normes de production de haute qualité. C'est l'occasion pour vous d'élaborer des décisions techniques, de contribuer à des stratégies d'outils à long terme et d'apporter des améliorations significatives à la stabilité, à la disponibilité et au rendement des processus. Êtes-vous quelqu'un qui prend possession, prospère dans un environnement rapide, et aime faire un impact réel? Alors appliquez aujourd'hui !

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Veiller à ce que les processus atteignent les objectifs du programme de production et du rendement et s'attaquer aux problèmes de rendement et de retravail des produits.

• Mobiliser les fournisseurs d'équipements et de matériaux pour développer de nouvelles solutions et améliorer les processus existants, pour assurer le bon fonctionnement de la chaîne de production.

• Élaborer de nouvelles techniques, modifier les conceptions existantes et coordonner les projets d'amélioration des processus.

• Analyser les données de processus pour identifier les tendances, optimiser les performances et résoudre les problèmes (mise en œuvre et vérification régulière du CPS).

• Planification indépendante et mise en place de nouvelles machines dans la chaîne de production.

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'intégration des procédés, d'écharpe humide, de diffusion, de métaux, d'écharpe sèche et d'implants pour assurer une production transparente.

• Prend en charge certains outils de métrologie, c'est-à-dire mesurer CD et Overlay.

• Les services de garde le week-end et les jours fériés (selon les besoins de la production) avec la participation à la réunion de garde (avant le service de garde) ont convenu de sa propre responsabilité avec les autres fournisseurs de services de garde.

Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat dans un domaine connexe (p. ex., électrique, mécanique, chimique, science des matériaux ou physique) avec 5+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou maîtrise avec 3+ années d'expérience dans l'industrie ou doctorat avec expérience de l'industrie

• Expérience approfondie dans les opérations de photolithographie des wafers, en particulier dans le revêtement et l'exposition chez Steppers, dans un environnement de fabrication des wafers (fabrication des wafers à tête mince et à semi-conducteur)

• Familiarité avec les systèmes logiciels automatisés d'usine de wafer comme SPC, MES et Expérience avec l'extraction, la manipulation et l'analyse de données

• Forte compréhension de l'optique et de la lithographie d'immersion

• Bonnes compétences en anglais et en allemand

• Capacité de travailler dans un environnement propre

jobs.title: Project Quality Specialist 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our international project organization and  drive quality across large and complex projects. In this role, you will work closely with project teams, customers, suppliers, and site organizations to ensure that quality requirements are understood, implemented, and continuously improved.

You will act as a trusted quality partner to the Project Manager, helping the team achieve project objectives, manage risks, and deliver a high level of customer satisfaction. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who combines technical quality expertise with strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and the confidence to influence stakeholders across a global matrix organization.

How you'll make an impact

• Plan, organize, lead, and monitor quality-related project activities, resources, objectives, KPIs, and deliverables

• Develop, implement, and maintain the Project Quality Plan and ensure compliance with contractual requirements and the ISO 9001-certified Quality Management System

• Collaborate closely with project teams, suppliers, site organizations, and other key stakeholders

• Lead and follow up on project quality audits, non-conformances, corrective actions, lessons learned, quality risks, and continuous improvement activities

• Monitor and report relevant quality indicators, including non-conformance reports, customer complaint resolution, cost of poor quality, project savings, and customer satisfaction

• Coordinate quality requirements for critical equipment, including supplier documentation, Inspection and Test Plans, Master Test Plans, inspections, and shipment-release reviews

• Support site quality activities, including training, audits, inspections, documentation handover, and project close-out

• Promote a strong quality culture and use structured problem-solving and lean methodologies to improve quality throughout project execution

Your background

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, science, or a related field; a master's degree is an advantage

• At least five years of professional experience in EPC project quality management within a large and complex organization; experience in the power, energy, renewable energy, or oil and gas sectors is preferred

• Sound knowledge of ISO 9001; internal-auditor certification is considered an advantage

• Good understanding on SAP Quality Module as well as  project and risk management; knowledge of PMI methodologies or CAPM-PMI certification is beneficial

• Experience with supplier and site quality processes, including Inspection and Test Plans, PPAP, inspections, testing procedures, punch lists, mechanical completion, and lessons learned

• Knowledge of quality and problem-solving methodologies such as 8D, root cause analysis, PDCA, 5 Why, Lean Six Sigma, and FMEA

• Excellent English communication skills, combined with a structured, proactive, solution-oriented, and collaborative working style; German or other additional languages are an advantage

• Confidence working in an international matrix environment and willingness to travel to project construction sites and supplier locations when required

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

• Sostenere le attività di qualità del sito, tra cui formazione, audit, ispezioni, documentazione di consegna e progetto close-out

• Conoscenza sonora della certificazione ISO 9001; la certificazione interna-auditor è considerata un vantaggio

• Buona comprensione sul modulo di qualità SAP così come la gestione del progetto e del rischio; la conoscenza delle metodologie PMI o la certificazione CAPM-PMI è vantaggioso

• Esperienza con i processi di qualità del fornitore e del sito, compresi i piani di ispezione e test, PPAP, ispezioni, procedure di test, liste di punzonatura, completamento meccanico e lezioni apprese

• Eccellente capacitÃ di comunicazione inglese, combinata con uno stile di lavoro strutturato, proattivo, orientato alla soluzione e collaborativo; Tedesco o altre lingue aggiuntive sono un vantaggio

• Confidenza che lavora in un ambiente di matrice internazionale e la volontà di viaggiare a siti di costruzione di progetto e sedi dei fornitori quando necessario

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

• Coordonner les exigences de qualité pour l'équipement essentiel, y compris la documentation du fournisseur, les plans d'inspection et d'essai, les plans directeurs d'essais, les inspections et les examens des expéditions et des rejets

• Activités d'appui à la qualité du site, y compris la formation, les audits, les inspections, le transfert de documentation et la clôture du projet

• Promouvoir une culture de qualité forte et utiliser des méthodes structurées de résolution de problèmes et de maigres méthodes pour améliorer la qualité tout au long de l'exécution du projet

Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat en génie, en sciences ou dans un domaine connexe; une maîtrise est un avantage

• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience professionnelle dans la gestion de la qualité des projets EPC au sein d'une organisation vaste et complexe; l'expérience dans les secteurs de l'énergie, de l'énergie, des énergies renouvelables ou du pétrole et du gaz est privilégiée

• Bonne connaissance de la norme ISO 9001; la certification interne des auditeurs est considérée comme un avantage

• Bonne compréhension du module qualité SAP ainsi que de la gestion des projets et des risques; la connaissance des méthodologies PMI ou de la certification CAPM-PMI est bénéfique

• Expérience des processus de qualité des fournisseurs et des sites, y compris les plans d'inspection et d'essai, le PPAP, les inspections, les procédures d'essai, les listes de poinçonnage, l'achèvement mécanique et les leçons apprises

• Connaissance des méthodes de qualité et de résolution de problèmes telles que 8D, analyse des causes profondes, PDCA, 5 Why, Lean Six Sigma et FMEA

• Excellentes compétences en communication anglaise, combinées à un style de travail structuré, proactif, axé sur la solution et collaboratif; l'allemand ou d'autres langues supplémentaires sont un avantage

• Confiance dans un environnement matriciel international et volonté de se rendre sur les chantiers de construction et les sites de fournisseurs au besoin

Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

jobs.title: Project Manager Primary Engineering 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy, High Voltage Products, is renowned worldwide as a specialist for power transmission and distribution. Our unit Gas-Insulated Switchgears (GIS), based in Zürich-Oerlikon, is active in the development and production of gas insulated switching systems. We ensure the high reliability of our systems by using state-of-the-art development tools and methods.

As a Project Lead Engineer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end execution of gas-insulated switchgear (GIS) projects, ensuring seamless coordination from initial planning to final delivery. You will oversee technical design, procurement, and stakeholder interactions, ensuring that all aspects of the project align with quality standards, budget constraints, and deadlines. Your expertise in engineering, project management, and cross-functional collaboration will be essential in optimizing processes, driving innovation, and delivering exceptional results to customers.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great talent comes in many forms. If you are interested in this role but don't meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply. Your unique experience and perspective could be exactly what we're looking for.

How you'll make an impact

• Project Planning & Execution: Develop and manage technical project plans, ensuring alignment with customer requirements, industry regulations, and internal processes

• Engineering & Technical Documentation: Prepare and review engineering documents, such as technical specifications, drawings, assembly instructions, and material lists

• Stakeholder & Customer Coordination: Serve as the primary technical point of contact for customers, internal engineering teams, suppliers, and subcontractor

• Material & Supply Chain Management: Define material requirements, oversee procurement, and ensure correct configurations for fabrication and assembly

• Budget & Timeline Control: Track project costs, monitor progress against deadlines, and implement corrective actions as needed

• Quality Assurance & Process Improvement: Identify and resolve technical issues, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure compliance with quality standards

• Site Support & Commissioning: Provide on-site technical assistance during installation, testing, and commissioning phases

Your background

• Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

• Min 5 years of experience in project engineering, ideally in gas-insulated switchgear (GIS), power transmission, or related high-voltage equipment

• Technical Skills: Proficiency in CAD software (Creo, AutoCAD) for design and engineering documentation

• Project Management & Tools: Experience with SAP, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word), and scheduling tools

• Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve project-related issues efficiently

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to coordinate across multiple teams, including R&D, production, procurement, and quality assurance

• International Experience: Comfortable working in a global environment, collaborating with diverse stakeholders, and adapting to different work cultures

• Language & Travel: Fluent in English; knowledge of German is a plus

• Willingness to travel occasionally for project meetings and site visits

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Hitachi Energy, prodotti ad alta tensione, è rinomata in tutto il mondo come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. La nostra unità Gas-Insulated Switchgears (GIS), con sede a Zürich-Oerlikon, è attiva nello sviluppo e nella produzione di sistemi di commutazione isolata a gas. Garantiamo l'elevata affidabilità dei nostri sistemi utilizzando strumenti e metodi di sviluppo all'avanguardia.

In qualità di Project Lead Engineer, sarai responsabile dell'esecuzione end-to-end dei progetti di switchgear (GIS) isolati a gas, garantendo un coordinamento senza soluzione di continuità dalla pianificazione iniziale alla consegna finale. Potrai supervisionare la progettazione tecnica, gli appalti e le interazioni degli stakeholder, assicurando che tutti gli aspetti del progetto si allineano con standard di qualità, vincoli di bilancio e scadenze. La vostra esperienza nell'ingegneria, nella gestione dei progetti e nella collaborazione interfunzionale sarà essenziale per ottimizzare i processi, guidare l'innovazione e fornire risultati eccezionali ai clienti.

A Hitachi Energy, sappiamo che il grande talento viene in molte forme. Se siete interessati a questo ruolo, ma non soddisfare ogni esigenza, vi incoraggiamo ancora ad applicare. La vostra esperienza unica e la vostra prospettiva potrebbe essere esattamente quello che stiamo cercando.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Project Planning & Execution: Sviluppare e gestire piani di progetto tecnici, garantendo l'allineamento con i requisiti del cliente, le normative del settore e i processi interni

• Ingegneria & Documentazione tecnica: Preparare e rivedere documenti di ingegneria, come specifiche tecniche, disegni, istruzioni di montaggio e liste materiali

• Stakeholder & Customer Coordina: Servire come punto di contatto tecnico primario per clienti, team di ingegneria interna, fornitori e subappaltatore

• Gestione delle catene di materiali e di alimentazione: Definire i requisiti dei materiali, supervisionare gli appalti e garantire le configurazioni corrette per la fabbricazione e il montaggio

• Budget & Timeline Control: monitorare i costi del progetto, monitorare i progressi contro le scadenze e implementare azioni correttive secondo le necessità

• Quality Assurance & Process Improvement: Identificare e risolvere problemi tecnici, guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo e garantire il rispetto degli standard di qualità

• Supporto del sito & Commissioning: fornire assistenza tecnica in loco durante le fasi di installazione, test e messa in servizio

Il tuo sfondo

• Qualifiche educative: laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, o un campo correlato

• Min 5 anni di esperienza nell'ingegneria del progetto, idealmente in commutatore isolato a gas (GIS), trasmissione di potenza, o relative apparecchiature ad alta tensione

• Competenze tecniche: competenza nel software CAD (Creo, AutoCAD) per la progettazione e la documentazione ingegneristica

• Gestione del progetto e strumenti: esperienza con SAP, Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word) e strumenti di programmazione

• Problem-Solving & Decision-Making: Forte mentalità analitica con la capacità di identificare e risolvere i problemi legati al progetto in modo efficiente

• Collaborazione trasversale: Capacità di coordinare tra più squadre, tra cui R&D, produzione, approvvigionamento e garanzia di qualità

• Esperienza internazionale: lavoro confortevole in un ambiente globale, collaborazione con diversi stakeholder e adattamento a diverse culture di lavoro

• Lingua e viaggio: fluente in inglese; la conoscenza del tedesco è un plus

• Volontà di viaggiare occasionalmente per incontri di progetto e visite al sito

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Project Control Engineer – Power Conversion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, and grid interconnections.
Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency.
To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for a motivated and hands-on Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems.
If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.

How you'll make an impact

• Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation

• Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams

• Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews

• Develop and implement control software, including testing on real-time simulation platforms

• Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site

• Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery

• Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation

• Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management

Your background

• Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences)

• Hands-on experience with MATLAB / Simulink is essential

• Strong knowledge of process control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI)

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus

• Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage

• Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time)

• Fluency in English and German

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Additionally, you can expect:

• Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics

• Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications

• A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work

• Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business

• Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team

descriptionByLocale.it:

• Coordinare le interfacce tecniche tra clienti, subfornitori e team interni

• Definire e valutare le interfacce hardware, compresi i componenti elettrici e le recensioni di progettazione

• Sviluppare e implementare software di controllo, inclusi i test sulle piattaforme di simulazione in tempo reale

• Eseguire la messa in cantiere, il test e la formazione del cliente

• Sostenere il team di vendita nella preparazione di concetti tecnici e tenera documentazione

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di controllo, sistema e ingegneria meccanica e la gestione dei progetti

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in ingegneria elettrica (Bachelor's o Masters, da un'università o università di scienze applicate)

• Esperienza pratica con MATLAB / Simulink è essenziale

• Forte conoscenza del controllo del processo e della progettazione del software (ad esempio OLC, CLC, Protezione, HMI)

• La familiarità con i protocolli di comunicazione industriale (ad esempio OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) è un plus

• L'esperienza iniziale in test, messa in servizio o ingegneria applicata è un vantaggio

• Fluency in inglese e tedesco

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Inoltre, ci si può aspettare:

• Lavorare sulle tecnologie all'avanguardia in Power Electronics

• Esperienza pratica in progetti internazionali e applicazioni nel mondo reale

• Una combinazione di simulazione, ingegneria e lavoro di progetto in loco

• Opportunità di crescere in un esperto tecnico all'interno di un business in rapido sviluppo

• Collaborazione all'interno di un team di ingegneria internazionale altamente qualificato
