jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit
Als Field Service Engineer bei HITACHI ENERGY LTD bist du für die Installation, Wartung und Reparatur unserer Produkte und Systeme direkt beim Kunden in der Schweiz verantwortlich. Du stellst die optimale Leistung und Verfügbarkeit der Anlagen sicher und leistest damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden.

Das kannst du bewirken

• Durchführung von Installationen, Inbetriebnahmen, Wartungen und Reparaturen an HITACHI ENERGY Produkten und Systemen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Hochspannung, Energieübertragung und -verteilung.

• Fehleranalyse und -behebung an komplexen elektrotechnischen Anlagen und Systemen.

• Erstellung von Serviceberichten und Dokumentationen nach jedem Einsatz.

• Beratung der Kunden bezüglich technischer Fragestellungen und Optimierungsmöglichkeiten.

• Schulung von Kundenpersonal im Umgang mit den Anlagen.

• Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorschriften und Qualitätsstandards.

• Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeiten innerhalb der Schweiz und gelegentlich ins Ausland.

• Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst (Pikett) ausserhalb der regulären Arbeitszeiten.

• Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung und Aktualisierung des Fachwissens über neue Produkte und Technologien.

Dein Hintergrund

• Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung (z.B. Elektriker/in, Elektroniker/in, Automatiker/in) oder Studium (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik).

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Service oder Wartung von elektrischen Anlagen, idealerweise in der Energiebranche.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hochspannungstechnik, Schaltanlagen und Steuerungssystemen sind von Vorteil.

• Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten.

• Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Schweizerdeutsch von Vorteil), sowie gute Englischkenntnisse. Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und analytisches Denkvermögen.

• Hohes Mass an Eigeninitiative, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Kundenorientierung.

• Gültiger Führerausweis Kategorie B.

• Bereitschaft zu flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Reisetätigkeit.

Mehr über uns
Wir bieten spannende und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum sowie attraktive Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Dich erwarten interessante und vielseitige Tätigkeiten und Projekte, einschließlich Offshore‑Einsätzen, ein eingespieltes und dynamisches Team und eine offene Unternehmenskultur. Darüber hinaus profitierst du von einem attraktiven Leistungspaket mit festen Reise‑ und Verpflegungspauschalen sowie einem Mitspracherecht bei der Wahl der Unterkunft.

descriptionByLocale.it:
La possibilità
In qualità di ingegnere del servizio sul campo HITACHI ENERGY LTD, sei responsabile dell'installazione, della manutenzione e della riparazione dei nostri prodotti e sistemi direttamente al cliente in Svizzera. Garantisci le prestazioni e la disponibilità ottimali dei sistemi e quindi un contributo significativo alla soddisfazione dei nostri clienti.

Puoi farlo.

• Attuazione di impianti, messa in servizio, manutenzione e riparazione di prodotti e sistemi HITACHI ENERGY, soprattutto nelle aree di alta tensione, trasmissione e distribuzione di energia.

• Analisi degli errori e correzione di apparecchiature e sistemi elettrici complessi.

• Creazione di rapporti di servizio e documentazione dopo ogni distribuzione.

• Consultare i clienti su questioni tecniche e opzioni di ottimizzazione.

• Formazione del personale del cliente nella gestione delle strutture.

• Rispetto alle normative di sicurezza e agli standard di qualità.

• Volontà di viaggiare in Svizzera e occasionalmente all'estero.

• Partecipazione al servizio on-call (piket) al di fuori delle ore di lavoro regolari.

• Formazione continua e aggiornamento delle competenze sui nuovi prodotti e tecnologie.

Il tuo sfondo

• Formazione tecnica completata (ad esempio elettricista, ingegnere elettronico, automatista) o studi (ad esempio ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria energetica).

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel campo del servizio o della manutenzione di impianti elettrici, idealmente nel settore dell'energia.

• La conoscenza approfondita della tecnologia ad alta tensione, dei sistemi di commutazione e di controllo è vantaggiosa.

• Uso sicuro delle apparecchiature di misura e di prova.

• Buona conoscenza del tedesco nelle parole e nella scrittura (Swiss tedesco è un vantaggio), così come buona conoscenza dell'inglese. La conoscenza del francese è un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità di problem solving e capacità di pensiero analitico.

• Alto grado di iniziativa, senso di responsabilità e orientamento del cliente.

• Patente di guida valida categoria B.

• Volontà di lavorare ore flessibili e viaggi.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
Offriamo attività emozionanti e diversificate con grande ambito creativo e interessanti opportunità di formazione e sviluppo. Puoi aspettarti attività e progetti interessanti e versatili, tra cui operazioni offshore, un team consolidato e dinamico e una cultura aziendale aperta. Inoltre, si beneficia di un attraente pacchetto di servizi con viaggi fissi e pacchetti di cibo, così come una voce nella scelta di alloggio.
descriptionByLocale.en:
The possibility
As a field service engineer at HITACHI ENERGY LTD, you are responsible for the installation, maintenance and repair of our products and systems directly at the customer in Switzerland. You ensure the optimal performance and availability of the systems and thus make a significant contribution to the satisfaction of our customers.

You can do that.

• Implementation of installations, commissioning, maintenance and repairs of HITACHI ENERGY products and systems, especially in the areas of high voltage, energy transmission and distribution.

• Error analysis and correction of complex electrical equipment and systems.

• Creation of service reports and documentation after each deployment.

• Advising customers on technical issues and optimization options.

• Training of customer personnel in the handling of the facilities.

• Compliance with safety regulations and quality standards.

• Willingness to travel within Switzerland and occasionally abroad.

• Participation in on-call service (piket) outside regular working hours.

• Continuous training and updating of expertise on new products and technologies.

Your background

• Completed technical training (e.g. electrician, electronics engineer, automatist) or studies (e.g. electrical engineering, energy engineering).

• Several years of professional experience in the field of service or maintenance of electrical systems, ideally in the energy industry.

• In-depth knowledge of high-voltage technology, switchgear and control systems is advantageous.

• Safe use of measuring and testing equipment.

• Good knowledge of German in words and writing (Swiss German is an advantage), as well as good knowledge of English. Knowledge of French is a plus.

• Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking skills.

• High degree of initiative, sense of responsibility and customer orientation.

• Valid driving licence category B.

• Willingness to work flexible hours and travel.

More about us
We offer exciting and varied tasks with great creative scope as well as attractive further education and development opportunities. You can expect interesting and versatile activities and projects, including offshore operations, a well-established and dynamic team and an open corporate culture. In addition, you benefit from an attractive service package with fixed travel and food packages as well as a say in the choice of accommodation.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are looking for a Project Manager to strengthen our Team in our Business Unit Transformers, Ticino.
In this role you are leading the execution of medium-size projects mainly related to LV & MV Transformers and Reactors and ensure that all related activities are performed in accordance with Hitachi Energy policy, quality standards, health & safety and environment requirements.
Our flexible work practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Please submit your resume in English.

How you'll make an impact

• Developing project schedules, and determining resource requirements

• Monitoring and reporting on the status of projects including cost, timing, and staffing

• Ensuring adherence to internal and external quality standards (e.g., International Standards Organization)

• Manage After-Sales projects by ensuring the fulfillment of customer needs

• Identifying/resolving obstacles to completing project on time and to budget

• May include work managing multiple, interrelated projects (including business transformation projects)

• On some projects, the work may include integrating vendor tasks into the project plan and tracking and reviewing vendor deliverables

Your background

• Electrical Engineering or mechanical Engineering Background

• 2-3 years proven experience in Project Management with focus on Transformers and Reactors

• Collaboration with diverse number of stakeholders

• Very good knowledge of English and Italian; any other languages are a plus

• Strong communicator, self-driven and open-minded

• Structured and organized person with the ability to work under time pressure

• Team-player able to build and motivate a project team

More about us
Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: GPG Insulation & Components APQP Leader
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
As an GPG Insulation & Components APQP Leader you will be responsible for the implementation and maintenance of Foundation APQP essentials, according to the defined strategy and plan for GPG I&C Quality. You will collaborate with crossfunctional teams ensuring that Foundation APQP essentials are updated according to novelties and new risks.

How you´ll make an impact

• Coordinate the development of Foundation APQP plan.

• Lead foundation APQP Plan related meetings, collecting and preparing documentation, being main connection point between QMT, Factories, Global experts and R&D.

• Participate in Foundation FMEA workshops and support HUBs and Factories to use foundation APQP essentials (to be cascaded to local products).

• Support R&D organization to use foundation APQP essentials for new product developments.

• Support ToT projects to ensure proper transfer of APQP essentials.

• Act as GPG I&C Plato Admin, train crossfunctional teams, support the organization on the usage and ensure that foundation content is updated.

• Proactive identification of technology novelties to drive updates in foundation APQP essentials and collaborate with GPG Operations to identify global process changes that might affect to foundation APQP essentials (e.g. from best practices to requirement).

Your background

• Technical degree from the University.

• 3-5 years of experience with APQP (preferably in industries like Automotive or Wind).

• Strong knowledge of APQP processes, FMEA, PPAP, SPC, and MSA methodologies.

• Experience with Plato is an advatage.

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and implement process improvements.

• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and facilitate effective collaboration among diverse stakeholders.

• Fluency in English

What we offer

• Collective agreement and flexible working hours.

• Health care and wellness allowance.

• Career opportunities within Hitachi Energy, locally and globally.

• Mentor support during onboarding.

• Training and development programs.

• A diverse workplace with 70+ nationalities in Sweden.

• Supplementary parental leave compensation.

• Access to an Employee Benefit Portal with discounts.

More about us
At Hitachi Energy, you'll work in an exciting, collaborative environment delivering world-class technology. We value personal development and diversity, and we are committed to building a sustainable energy future. descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Come GPG Insulation & Components APQP Leader sarete responsabili per l'implementazione e la manutenzione degli elementi essenziali della Fondazione APQP, secondo la strategia definita e il piano per la qualità GPG I&C. Collaborerai con team interfunzionali per garantire che gli elementi essenziali della Fondazione APQP siano aggiornati in base alle novità e ai nuovi rischi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Coordinate lo sviluppo del piano APQP della Fondazione.

• Fondazione di piombo APQP Piano incontri correlati, raccolta e preparazione della documentazione, essendo il punto di collegamento principale tra QMT, Factories, esperti globali e R&D.

• Partecipa ai workshop della Fondazione FMEA e supporta HUB e Fabbriche per utilizzare le basi di base APQP essenziali (da cascaded ai prodotti locali).

• Supporta l'organizzazione R&D per utilizzare le basi APQP essenziali per nuovi sviluppi del prodotto.

• Sostegno ai progetti ToT per garantire un corretto trasferimento di elementi essenziali APQP.

• Agire come GPG I&C Plato Admin, formare squadre interfunzionali, sostenere l'organizzazione sull'uso e garantire che il contenuto di fondazione è aggiornato.

• Identificazione attiva delle novità tecnologiche per guidare gli aggiornamenti negli essenziali APQP di fondazione e collaborare con GPG Operations per identificare i cambiamenti di processo globali che potrebbero influire sugli essenziali APQP di fondazione (ad esempio dalle migliori pratiche ai requisiti).

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea tecnica presso l'Università.

• 3-5 anni di esperienza con APQP (preferibilmente in industrie come Automotive o Wind).

• Forte conoscenza dei processi APQP, delle metodologie FMEA, PPAP, SPC e MSA.

• L'esperienza con Plato è un'avanzata.

• Eccellente analitica e problem solving competenze con la capacità di identificare e implementare miglioramenti di processo.

• Prove capacità di guidare team interfunzionali e facilitare una collaborazione efficace tra i diversi stakeholder.

• Fluency in inglese

Cosa offriamo

• Accordo collettivo e orari di lavoro flessibili.

• Salute e benessere.

• Opportunità di carriera all'interno di Hitachi Energy, a livello locale e globale.

• Supporto da mentore durante l'imbarco.

• Programmi di formazione e sviluppo.

• Un luogo di lavoro diverso con 70+ nazionalità in Svezia.

• Compensazione supplementare del congedo parentale.

• Accesso a un Portale dei Benefit dei Dipendenti con sconti.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi
In Hitachi Energy, lavorerai in un ambiente collaborativo e coinvolgente, offrendo tecnologie di livello mondiale. Apprezziamo lo sviluppo personale e la diversità, e ci impegniamo a costruire un futuro energetico sostenibile. Stiamo crescendo e accogliamo i candidati che non possono soddisfare ogni esigenza, le vostre questioni potenziali.

Le applicazioni vengono esaminate su base continuativa, quindi non aspettare – applichiamo oggi!

Per domande sulla posizione, contattare Recruiting Manager Yolanda Villaseca a yolanda.villaseca@hitachienergy.com. Rappresentanti dell'Unione: Sveriges Ingenjörer: Håkan Blomquist +46 107-38 31 52, Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt +46 107 38 70 42. Tutte le altre domande possono essere indirizzate a Talent Partner Michael Blomberg, michael.blomberg@hitachienergy.com

Die Chance
Als GPG Insulation & Components APQP Leader sind Sie für die Implementierung und Wartung der Foundation APQP Essentials gemäß der definierten Strategie und dem Plan für GPG I&C Quality verantwortlich. Sie werden mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammenarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Grundlagen von Foundation APQP nach Neuheiten und neuen Risiken aktualisiert werden.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen

• Koordinieren Sie die Entwicklung des Foundation APQP-Plans.

• Lead Foundation APQP Plan bezogene Treffen, Sammlung und Vorbereitung von Dokumentation, als Hauptverbindungspunkt zwischen QMT, Fabriken, globalen Experten und F & E.

• Nehmen Sie an FMEA-Workshops der Stiftung teil und unterstützen Sie HUBs und Fabriken bei der Verwendung von APQP-Grundlagen der Stiftung (zur Kaskade lokaler Produkte).

• Unterstützung der F & E-Organisation bei der Verwendung von APQP-Grundlagen für neue Produktentwicklungen.

• Unterstützung von ToT-Projekten, um eine ordnungsgemäße Übertragung von APQP-Grundlagen zu gewährleisten.

• Agieren Sie als GPG I&C Plato Admin, trainieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Teams, unterstützen Sie die Organisation bei der Nutzung und sorgen Sie dafür, dass die Inhalte der Stiftung aktualisiert werden.

• Proaktive Identifizierung von Technologieneuheiten, um Updates in den Grundlagen-APQP-Grundlagen voranzutreiben und mit GPG Operations zusammenzuarbeiten, um globale Prozessänderungen zu identifizieren, die sich auf die Grundlagen-APQP-Grundlagen auswirken könnten (z. B. von Best Practices bis hin zu Anforderung).

Dein Hintergrund

• Technische Grad von der Universität.

• 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung mit APQP (vorzugsweise in Branchen wie Automotive oder Wind).

• Fundiertes Wissen über APQP-Prozesse, FMEA, PPAP, SPC und MSA-Methoden.

• Die Erfahrung mit Plato ist ein Vorteil.

• Hervorragende analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Prozessverbesserungen zu identifizieren und zu implementieren.

• Bewährte Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams zu führen und eine effektive Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Interessengruppen zu ermöglichen.

• Fluency in Englisch

Was wir anbieten

• Tarifvereinbarung und flexible Arbeitszeiten.

• Gesundheitsfürsorge und Wellness-Zulage.

• Karrieremöglichkeiten bei Hitachi Energy, lokal und global.

• Mentorenunterstützung beim Onboarding.

• Ausbildungs- und Entwicklungsprogramme.

• Ein vielseitiger Arbeitsplatz mit über 70 Nationalitäten in Schweden.

• Zusätzliche Elternurlaubsentschädigung.

• Zugang zu einem Employee Benefit Portal mit Rabatten.

Mehr über uns
Bei Hitachi Energy arbeiten Sie in einer aufregenden, kollaborativen Umgebung und liefern Weltklasse-Technologie. Wir legen Wert auf persönliche Entwicklung und Vielfalt und setzen uns für den Aufbau einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft ein. Wir wachsen und begrüßen Bewerber, die möglicherweise nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen - Ihre potenziellen Angelegenheiten.

Bewerbungen werden laufend überprüft, also warten Sie nicht - bewerben Sie sich noch heute!

jobs.title: Territory Sales & Marketing Manager 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity
Hitachi Energy Insulation and Components portfolio covers a wide range of transformer applications, from the small distribution transformers till the bigger power transformers. Our customers portfolio includes Transformer OEMs, components distributors, utilities as well as services companies. In order to support our operations in Europe, we are looking for an experienced Territory Sales and Marketing Manager who will manage a part of the DACH region, mainly the German market. The role can be based either in Germany or Switzerland.

How you will make an impact

• Will be responsible for Sales and Marketing of full I&C portfolio within allocated countries for 3rd party transformer OEMs. Also accountable for delivering OR budget for all applicable I&C factories, for direct customers and also end-customers

• Conduct technical trainings for all types of customers

• Liaise with our I&C factories globally in order that quotations and proper technical support are provided. Manage product customization projects.

• Liaise with Utilities in order to homologate and have approved I&C portfolio, clarify tender specifications

• Feed Market Intelligence to I&C factories, to our Global Product Group and to our local product managers

• Provide a regular forecast on OR per country for the full I&C portfolio

• Collaborate with Hitachi Energy Sales channels and also 3rd parties on Service projects

• Create synergies between I&C factories in order to increase sales volumes per project

• Support all promotional Marketing events in Europe organised by I&C Product line Marketing

Your background

• Degree (Bachelor or Master) in a technical discipline, ideally Electrical or Mechanical engineering plus further qualification in business administration

• More than 10 years of experience in technical and international sales and marketing, supporting multiple products, customers and countries

• Market or product knowledge in the field of power transformers or distribution transformers insulation and components is essential

• Experience in business development, account management and cross-selling across systems, solutions, products and service categories

• Understanding of contract negotiation, risk management and commercial and legal terms

• Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, customer-focused. Ability to establish and manage long-term customer relationships. Excellent planning and organization skills

• Sound knowledge of MS Office and CRM, preferably Salesforce

• Business fluent in German and English, spoken and written, is a must. Any other European language skill is an advantage

• Be willing to travel for international business trips (up to 40%)

More about us

• You will do interesting and enriching work as part of a dynamic, passionate, and collaborative team committed to innovation and continuous improvement

• You will be stretched, encouraged, and supported to grow – we pride ourselves on providing strong learning and development opportunities

• We offer an environment that fosters collaboration, connection, and diversity of thought

• Our culture is one of a kind: come as you are and bring your unique attributes, passion, and drive to the design and management of Pensions & Benefits at Hitachi Energy, contributing to making us ‘the place to be' and to our purpose of advancing a sustainable energy future for all

• Flexible working, including hybrid/remote working opportunities

• A competitive compensation and benefits package

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Il portafoglio Hitachi Energy Insulation and Components copre una vasta gamma di applicazioni di trasformatori, dai piccoli trasformatori di distribuzione fino ai trasformatori di potenza più grandi. Il nostro portafoglio clienti comprende Transformer OEM, distributori di componenti, utility e società di servizi. Al fine di sostenere le nostre operazioni in Europa, stiamo cercando un esperto Territorio Sales and Marketing Manager che gestirà una parte della regione DACH, principalmente il mercato tedesco. Il ruolo può essere basato sia in Germania che in Svizzera.

Come si farà un impatto

• Sarà responsabile per le vendite e il marketing del portafoglio completo di I&C all'interno dei paesi assegnati per gli OEM del trasformatore di terze parti. E' anche responsabile della consegna del bilancio OR per tutte le fabbriche I&C applicabili, per clienti diretti e anche clienti finali

• Condurre allenamenti tecnici per tutti i tipi di clienti

• Liaise con le nostre fabbriche di I&C a livello globale in modo che vengano fornite citazioni e un adeguato supporto tecnico. Gestisci i progetti di personalizzazione del prodotto.

• Liaise with Utilities per omologare e aver approvato il portafoglio I&C, chiarire le specifiche di gara

• Feed Market Intelligence alle fabbriche I&C, al nostro Global Product Group e ai nostri product manager locali

• Fornire una previsione regolare su OR per paese per il portafoglio I&C completo

• Collabora con i canali di vendita di energia di Hitachi e anche terze parti sui progetti di servizio

• Creare sinergie tra fabbriche I&C al fine di aumentare i volumi di vendita per progetto

• Supporta tutti gli eventi di marketing promozionali in Europa organizzati da I&C

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea (Bachelor o Master) in una disciplina tecnica, idealmente ingegneria elettrica o meccanica più ulteriore qualifica in amministrazione aziendale

• Più di 10 anni di esperienza nelle vendite e nel marketing tecnici e internazionali, supportando più prodotti, clienti e paesi

• La conoscenza del mercato o del prodotto nel campo dei trasformatori di potenza o dell'isolamento dei trasformatori di distribuzione e dei componenti è essenziale

• Esperienza nello sviluppo aziendale, gestione account e cross-selling attraverso sistemi, soluzioni, prodotti e categorie di servizi

• Comprensione dei contratti di negoziazione, gestione dei rischi e termini commerciali e legali

• Eccezionale capacità di comunicazione e negoziazione, focalizzato sul cliente. Capacità di stabilire e gestire relazioni con i clienti a lungo termine. Ottima pianificazione e capacità organizzative

• Conoscenza del suono di MS Office e CRM, preferibilmente Salesforce

• Le imprese fluenti in tedesco e inglese, parlato e scritto, è un must. Qualsiasi altra competenza linguistica europea è un vantaggio

• Essere disposti a viaggiare per viaggi d'affari internazionali (fino al 40%)

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

• Farete un lavoro interessante e arricchente come parte di un team dinamico, appassionato e collaborativo impegnato in innovazione e miglioramento continuo

• Sarete allungati, incoraggiati e sostenuti a crescere – siamo orgogliosi di fornire forti opportunità di apprendimento e sviluppo

• Offriamo un ambiente che favorisce la collaborazione, la connessione e la diversità del pensiero

• La nostra cultura è uno dei tipi: vieni come te e porta i tuoi attributi unici, la passione, e guidare alla progettazione e gestione di Pensioni & Benefits a Hitachi Energy, contribuendo a farci “il posto dove stare” e al nostro scopo di promuovere un futuro energetico sostenibile per tutti

• Lavoro flessibile, comprese le opportunità di lavoro ibride/remote

• Un pacchetto di compensazione e benefici competitivi

jobs.title: Continuous Improvement Manager 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about driving operational excellence and creating measurable impact on the shop floor? As Continuous Improvement Manager, you will partner with factory and operations leaders to identify improvement opportunities, remove bottlenecks, and implement Lean Six Sigma initiatives across the value chain. This is a highly visible role where you will coach teams, lead transformational projects, and help shape a culture of continuous improvement across our manufacturing operations.

How you'll make an impact

• Act as a trusted Continuous Improvement advisor and sparring partner for Factory Managers, Operations Managers, and leadership teams, driving data-driven analyses, optimization initiatives, and operational excellence programs

• Work across the entire value chain to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, improve flow, and maximize overall business performance

• Maintain a strong shop-floor presence through regular Gemba activities, working side-by-side with operators, supervisors, and managers to identify opportunities, solve problems, and sustain improvements where value is created

• Drive and promote Kaizen Events and Rapid Improvement Workshops to accelerate problem-solving, eliminate waste, and deliver fast, sustainable results

• Train, coach, and mentor employees and leaders in Lean Six Sigma methodologies, supporting certification programs and building continuous improvement capabilities throughout the organization

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to map, analyze, redesign, and optimize end-to-end business processes

• Lead the deployment of Lean principles, standardization, best practices, and benchmarking activities across manufacturing sites

• Monitor, track, and communicate improvement program results through KPIs, ensuring sustainable implementation and measurable business impact

• Travel regularly to support factories, conduct workshops, coach teams, and drive improvement initiatives across the organization (minimum 20% travel required)

Your background

• Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering, Operations Management, or a related technical field

• Minimum 5 years of experience in Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence, or Process Engineering, with proven hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment. Factory experience is mandatory

• Strong understanding and practical application of Lean Six Sigma methodologies (Green Belt required, Black Belt preferred)

• Proven experience leading Kaizen Events, Gemba activities, process mapping, value stream analysis, root cause analysis, and change management initiatives

• Demonstrated ability to identify bottlenecks, remove constraints, and improve end-to-end value stream performance

• Strong communication, facilitation, training, and presentation skills, with experience delivering workshops and Lean Six Sigma certification programs

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and data-driven decision-making skills

• Self-driven, hands-on, and comfortable working on the shop floor alongside production teams to deliver sustainable improvements

• Willingness to travel regularly to support factories and improvement initiatives across the region (minimum 20% travel required)

• Fluent in English; German or Swedish is considered an advantage

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Sei appassionato di guidare l'eccellenza operativa e creare un impatto misurabile sul piano del negozio? In qualità di Responsabile del miglioramento continuo, partnerrai con i leader di fabbrica e di operazioni per identificare le opportunità di miglioramento, rimuovere i colli di bottiglia e implementare le iniziative di Lean Six Sigma in tutta la catena del valore. Questo è un ruolo molto visibile in cui potrete allenare team, condurre progetti di trasformazione, e contribuire a plasmare una cultura di miglioramento continuo attraverso le nostre operazioni di produzione.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Agire come consulente e partner di risparmio continuo di fiducia per Factory Manager, Operations Manager e team di leadership, guidando analisi, iniziative di ottimizzazione e programmi di eccellenza operativa

• Lavorare attraverso l'intera catena del valore per identificare i colli di bottiglia, rimuovere i vincoli, migliorare il flusso e massimizzare le prestazioni aziendali globali

• Mantenere una forte presenza sul pavimento del negozio attraverso regolari attività Gemba, lavorando fianco a fianco con gli operatori, i supervisori e i manager per identificare le opportunità, risolvere i problemi e sostenere i miglioramenti in cui il valore è creato

• Guidare e promuovere Kaizen Events e Rapid Improvement Workshop per accelerare la risoluzione dei problemi, eliminare i rifiuti e fornire risultati rapidi e sostenibili

• Train, coach e tutor dipendenti e leader nelle metodologie Lean Six Sigma, supportando programmi di certificazione e costruendo funzionalità di miglioramento continuo in tutta l'organizzazione

• Collabora con gli stakeholder interfunzionali per mappare, analizzare, ridisegnare e ottimizzare i processi aziendali end-to-end

• Guidare l'implementazione di principi Lean, standardizzazione, best practice e attività di benchmarking nei siti di produzione

• Monitorare, tracciare e comunicare i risultati del programma di miglioramento attraverso i KPI, assicurando l'implementazione sostenibile e l'impatto aziendale misurabile

• Viaggia regolarmente per sostenere fabbriche, condurre workshop, team di coach e guidare iniziative di miglioramento in tutta l'organizzazione (minimo 20% di viaggio richiesto)

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea o master in ingegneria, gestione delle operazioni, o un campo tecnico correlato

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in continuo miglioramento, eccellenza operativa o ingegneria di processo, con comprovata esperienza pratica in un ambiente di produzione. L'esperienza di fabbrica è obbligatoria

• Forte comprensione e applicazione pratica delle metodologie Lean Six Sigma (Green Belt richiesto, Black Belt preferito)

• Esperienza comprovata leader Kaizen Events, attività Gemba, mappatura dei processi, analisi del flusso di valore, analisi delle cause radice e iniziative di gestione dei cambiamenti

• Capacità dimostrata di identificare i colli di bottiglia, rimuovere i vincoli e migliorare le prestazioni del flusso di valore end-to-end

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, facilitazione, formazione e presentazione, con esperienza nella fornitura di workshop e programmi di certificazione Lean Six Sigma

• Eccellente analitica, problem solving e competenze decisionali basate sui dati

• Self-driven, hands-on e confortevole lavoro sul piano del negozio accanto ai team di produzione per fornire miglioramenti sostenibili

• Volontà di viaggiare regolarmente per sostenere fabbriche e iniziative di miglioramento in tutta la regione (minimo 20% di viaggio richiesto)

• Fluente in inglese; tedesco o svedese è considerato un vantaggio

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Die Chance

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, operative Exzellenz zu fördern und messbare Auswirkungen auf den Shopfloor zu erzielen? Als Continuous Improvement Manager arbeiten Sie mit Fabrik- und Betriebsleitern zusammen, um Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren, Engpässe zu beseitigen und Lean Six Sigma-Initiativen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette zu implementieren. • Handeln Sie als zuverlässiger Berater für kontinuierliche Verbesserungen und Sparringspartner für Factory Manager, Operations Manager und Führungsteams, um datengesteuerte Analysen, Optimierungsinitiativen und operationelle Exzellenzprogramme voranzutreiben.

• Arbeiten entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette, um Engpässe zu identifizieren, Einschränkungen zu beseitigen, den Fluss zu verbessern und die Gesamtleistung des Unternehmens zu maximieren

• Pflegen Sie eine starke Präsenz im Geschäft durch regelmäßige Gemba-Aktivitäten, arbeiten Sie Seite an Seite mit Betreibern, Vorgesetzten und Managern, um Chancen zu identifizieren, Probleme zu lösen und Verbesserungen zu unterstützen, wo Wert geschaffen wird

• Förderung und Förderung von Kaizen-Events und Workshops zur schnellen Verbesserung, um die Problemlösung zu beschleunigen, Abfall zu beseitigen und schnelle, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu liefern

• Trainieren, coachen und betreuen Sie Mitarbeiter und Führungskräfte in Lean Six Sigma-Methoden, unterstützen Sie Zertifizierungsprogramme und bauen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten im gesamten Unternehmen auf

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Stakeholdern zur Abbildung, Analyse, Neugestaltung und Optimierung von End-to-End-Geschäftsprozessen

• Führen Sie den Einsatz von Lean-Prinzipien, Standardisierung, Best Practices und Benchmarking-Aktivitäten in allen Produktionsstätten

• Überwachen, verfolgen und kommunizieren Sie die Ergebnisse des Verbesserungsprogramms durch KPIs, um eine nachhaltige Umsetzung und messbare Geschäftsauswirkungen zu gewährleisten

• Reisen Sie regelmäßig, um Fabriken zu unterstützen, Workshops durchzuführen, Teams zu coachen und Verbesserungsinitiativen in der gesamten Organisation voranzutreiben (mindestens 20% Reisebedarf)

Dein Hintergrund

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Engineering, Operations Management oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in den Bereichen Continuous Improvement, Operational Excellence oder Process Engineering mit nachgewiesener praktischer Erfahrung in einer Fertigungsumgebung. Factory Experience ist Pflicht

• Starkes Verständnis und praktische Anwendung von Lean Six Sigma Methoden (Green Belt erforderlich, Black Belt bevorzugt)

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Leitung von Kaizen Events, Gemba-Aktivitäten, Prozessmapping, Value-Stream-Analyse, Ursachenanalyse und Change-Management-Initiativen

• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Engpässe zu identifizieren, Einschränkungen zu beseitigen und die End-to-End-Wertstromleistung zu verbessern

• Starke Kommunikation, Erleichterung, Schulung und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit Erfahrung bei der Bereitstellung von Workshops und Lean Six Sigma-Zertifizierungsprogrammen

• Hervorragende analytische, problemlösende und datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfähigkeiten

• Selbstgesteuertes, praktisches und komfortables Arbeiten in der Werkstatt neben Produktionsteams, um nachhaltige Verbesserungen zu erzielen

• Bereitschaft, regelmäßig zu reisen, um Fabriken und Verbesserungsinitiativen in der gesamten Region zu unterstützen (mindestens 20% Reisebedarf)

jobs.title: Operating Unit Engineering Manager for Substation Automation Systems, HUB Europe
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
We are looking for an Engineering Manager within the Operating Unit, Substation Automation Systems Europe. In this role, you will provide the professional engineering resources required for the design, engineering, testing, and commissioning of systems delivered through commercial projects under the responsibility of the Operating Unit.
You will drive operational and execution excellence through effective engineering management while fostering collaboration across the engineering community within the Operating Unit's countries to share solutions, balance workloads, and leverage lessons learned.
Key responsibilities include:

• Allocating the right engineering resources to project teams in accordance with S&OP processes.

• Establishing efficient interfaces between engineering teams and OPCs while increasing OPC utilization.

• Managing customer relationships with respect to technical requirements.

In this role, you will report to the Operating Unit Manager, Substation Automation Systems Europe.

How You'll Make an Impact

• Lead the engineering teams and own the performance management of engineering deliverables across the Operating Unit in Europe.

• Serve as the Business Process Owner for engineering and testing processes.

• Mentor and develop engineering function leaders and team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, as well as internal and external stakeholders.

• Coordinate the implementation of and adherence to global engineering processes, standards, practices, procedures, tools, and digitalization initiatives in collaboration with the Global Product Group and other Operating Units across the Business Unit.

• Define and lead the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across engineering processes and tools, aligned with Business Unit and Global Product Group strategies.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Die Möglichkeit

Hitachi Energy High Voltage Products ist der weltweit anerkannte Spezialist für Energieübertragung und Energieverteilung. • Coordinate internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth project execution

• Communicate project plans, progress, and expectations clearly and proactively

• Assess resource requirements and ensure effective allocation throughout the project lifecycle

• Track Engineering project milestones, timelines, and deliverables using appropriate tools

• Identify technical risks early, manage changes in scope, and implement suitable mitigation measures

• Lead, coach, and motivate project team members, fostering accountability and high performance

• Conduct project reviews and capture key learnings, deriving actionable recommendations for future improvements

Your background

• Master's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering

• Minimum 5 years of experience in project execution within an engineering environment

• Experience with power systems and converter systems is a plus

• Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

• Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills

• Fluency in English is required; German is a plus

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Senior Project Control Engineer – Power Conversion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, hydro pumped storage systems and grid interconnections.

Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency.
To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced, motivated and hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems.

If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.

How you'll make an impact

• Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation

• Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams

• Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews

• Drive conceptual design, development and support in implementation of control software and testing on real-time simulation platforms

• Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site

• Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery

• Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation

• Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management

Your background

• Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences)

• Min. 5 years of relevant working experience

• Hands-on experience with MATLAB / Simulink is essential, with structed text programming and Hidraw as added advantage

• Strong knowledge of process and power electronics control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI)

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus

• Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage

• Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time)

• Fluency in English and German

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Additionally, you can expect:

• Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics

• Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications

• A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work

• Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business

• Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Al nostro Centro Competence “Power Converter Solutions”, siamo all’avanguardia nello sviluppo, nella produzione, nell’installazione e nella messa in servizio di convertitori elettronici ad alta potenza per applicazioni come STATCOM, sistemi di alimentazione ferroviaria, sistemi di stoccaggio idropompati e interconnessioni a rete.

Le nostre soluzioni svolgono un ruolo chiave nel consentire l'integrazione delle energie rinnovabili nelle moderne reti elettriche, migliorando al contempo l'efficienza complessiva del sistema.
Per rafforzare il nostro team di Control Engineering, stiamo cercando un esperto, motivato e hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer con un forte interesse per l'elettronica di potenza e sistemi di controllo.

Se sei un apprendista veloce con una mentalità strutturata e proattiva, e ti piace combinare lavoro di ingegneria con applicazioni reali - questa è la tua opportunità.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Pianificare ed eseguire gli aspetti di ingegneria di controllo dei progetti, compresi i concetti hardware e software, le specifiche e la documentazione

• Coordinare le interfacce tecniche tra clienti, subfornitori e team interni

• Definire e valutare le interfacce hardware, compresi i componenti elettrici e le recensioni di progettazione

• Guida progettazione, sviluppo e supporto concettuale nell'implementazione di software di controllo e test su piattaforme di simulazione in tempo reale

• Eseguire la messa in servizio, il test e la formazione del cliente in loco

• Fornire supporto tecnico durante l'esecuzione del progetto e dopo la consegna

• Sostenere il team di vendita nella preparazione di concetti tecnici e tenera documentazione

• Collabora a stretto contatto con i team di controllo, sistema e ingegneria meccanica e la gestione dei progetti

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in ingegneria elettrica (Bachelor's o Masters, da un'università o università di scienze applicate)

• Min. 5 anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante

• Esperienza pratica con MATLAB / Simulink è essenziale, con la programmazione di testo strutto e Hidraw come vantaggio aggiunto

• Forte conoscenza del controllo dell'elettronica di processo e di potenza e del software (ad esempio OLC, CLC, Protezione, HMI)

• La familiarità con i protocolli di comunicazione industriale (ad esempio OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) è un plus

• L'esperienza iniziale in test, messa in servizio o ingegneria applicata è un vantaggio

• Volontà di viaggiare a livello globale per commissionare incarichi (circa il 20% del tempo di lavoro)

• Fluency in inglese e tedesco

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

Inoltre, puoi aspettarti:

• Lavorare sulle tecnologie all'avanguardia in Power Electronics

• Esperienza pratica in progetti internazionali e applicazioni nel mondo reale

• Una combinazione di simulazione, ingegneria e lavoro di progetto in loco

• Opportunità di crescere in un esperto tecnico all'interno di un business in rapido sviluppo

• Collaborazione all'interno di un team di ingegneria internazionale altamente qualificato
descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

At our Competence Center “Power Converter Solutions”, we are at the forefront of developing, manufacturing, installing, and commissioning high-power electronic converters for applications such as STATCOM, rail power supply systems, hydro pumped storage systems and grid interconnections.

Our solutions play a key role in enabling the integration of renewable energy into modern power grids while improving overall system efficiency.
To strengthen our Control Engineering team, we are looking for an experienced, motivated and hands-on Senior Project Control Engineer with a strong interest in power electronics and control systems.

If you are a fast learner with a structured and proactive mindset, and you enjoy combining engineering work with real-world applications — this is your opportunity.

How you'll make an impact

• Plan and execute control engineering aspects of projects, including hardware and software concepts, specifications, and documentation

• Coordinate technical interfaces between customers, sub-suppliers, and internal teams

• Define and evaluate hardware interfaces, including electrical components and design reviews

• Drive conceptual design, development and support in implementation of control software and testing on real-time simulation platforms

• Perform commissioning, testing, and customer training on-site

• Provide technical support during project execution and after delivery

• Support the sales team in the preparation of technical concepts and tender documentation

• Collaborate closely with control, system, and mechanical engineering teams as well as project management

Your background

• Degree in Electrical Engineering (Bachelor's or Master's, from a university or university of applied sciences)

• Min. 5 years of relevant working experience

• Hands-on experience with MATLAB / Simulink is essential, with structed text programming and Hidraw as added advantage

• Strong knowledge of process and power electronics control and software design (e.g. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI)

• Familiarity with industrial communication protocols (e.g. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) is a plus

• Initial experience in testing, commissioning, or applied engineering is an advantage

• Willingness to travel globally for commissioning assignments (approx. 20% of working time)

• Fluency in English and German

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Additionally, you can expect:

• Work on cutting-edge technologies in Power Electronics

• Hands-on experience in international projects and real-world applications

• A combination of simulation, engineering, and on-site project work

• Opportunity to grow into a technical expert within a rapidly developing business

• Collaboration within a highly skilled, international engineering team
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

In unserem Competence Center „Power Converter Solutions sind wir an der Spitze der Entwicklung, Herstellung, Installation und Inbetriebnahme von elektronischen Hochleistungswandlern für Anwendungen wie STATCOM, Schienenstromversorgungssysteme, hydrogepumpte Speichersysteme und Netzanbindungen.

Unsere Lösungen spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Integration erneuerbarer Energien in moderne Stromnetze bei gleichzeitiger Verbesserung der Gesamtsystemeffizienz.
Um unser Control Engineering Team zu stärken, suchen wir einen erfahrenen, motivierten und praxisnahen Senior Project Control Engineer mit einem starken Interesse an Leistungselektronik und Steuerungssystemen.

Wenn Sie ein schneller Lernender mit einer strukturierten und proaktiven Denkweise sind und es genießen, Ingenieurarbeit mit realen Anwendungen zu kombinieren, ist dies Ihre Chance.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Planung und Durchführung steuerungstechnischer Aspekte von Projekten, einschließlich Hardware- und Softwarekonzepten, Spezifikationen und Dokumentation

• Koordination der technischen Schnittstellen zwischen Kunden, Unterlieferanten und internen Teams

• Definieren und Bewerten von Hardware-Schnittstellen, einschließlich elektrischer Komponenten und Design-Reviews

• Konzeptionelles Design, Entwicklung und Unterstützung bei der Implementierung von Steuerungssoftware und Tests auf Echtzeit-Simulationsplattformen vorantreiben

• Durchführung von Inbetriebnahmen, Tests und Kundenschulungen vor Ort

• Technische Unterstützung während der Projektdurchführung und nach der Lieferung

• Unterstützung des Verkaufsteams bei der Erstellung von technischen Konzepten und Ausschreibungsunterlagen

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerungs-, System- und Maschinenbauteams sowie Projektmanagement

Dein Hintergrund

• Abschluss in Elektrotechnik (Bachelor oder Master, von einer Universität oder Fachhochschule)

• Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Berufserfahrung

• Praktische Erfahrung mit MATLAB / Simulink ist unerlässlich, mit strukturierter Textprogrammierung und Hidraw als zusätzlichen Vorteil

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der Steuerung der Prozess- und Leistungselektronik und des Softwaredesigns (z. B. OLC, CLC, Protection, HMI)

• Vertrautheit mit industriellen Kommunikationsprotokollen (z. B. OPC, IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3) ist ein Plus

• Erste Erfahrungen in Testing, Inbetriebnahme oder Applied Engineering sind von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft, weltweit für Auftragsarbeiten zu reisen (ca. 20% der Arbeitszeit)

• Fließend in Englisch und Deutsch

Mehr über uns

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsweisen helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

Darüber hinaus können Sie erwarten:

• Arbeiten an Spitzentechnologien in der Leistungselektronik

• Praxiserfahrung in internationalen Projekten und realen Anwendungen

• Eine Kombination aus Simulation, Engineering und Projektarbeit vor Ort

• Möglichkeit, in einem sich schnell entwickelnden Unternehmen zu einem technischen Experten zu werden

• Zusammenarbeit in einem hochqualifizierten, internationalen Engineering-Team
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Au sein de notre Centre de Compétences, nous sommes à l'avant-garde du développement, de la fabrication, de l'installation et de la mise en service de convertisseurs électroniques haute puissance pour des applications telles que STATCOM, les systèmes d'alimentation électrique ferroviaire, les systèmes de stockage hydropompés et les interconnexions de réseau.

Nos solutions jouent un rôle clé dans l'intégration des énergies renouvelables dans les réseaux électriques modernes tout en améliorant l'efficacité globale du système.
Pour renforcer notre équipe de Control Engineering, nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur de contrôle de projet expérimenté, motivé et pratique avec un intérêt marqué pour l'électronique de puissance et les systèmes de contrôle.

Si vous êtes un apprenant rapide avec un état d'esprit structuré et proactif, et vous aimez combiner le travail d'ingénierie avec des applications du monde réel — c'est votre opportunité.

Comment vous allez avoir un impact

• Planifier et exécuter les aspects techniques du contrôle des projets, y compris les concepts matériels et logiciels, les spécifications et la documentation

• Coordonner les interfaces techniques entre clients, sous-fournisseurs et équipes internes

• Définir et évaluer les interfaces matérielles, y compris les composants électriques et les examens de conception

• Diriger la conception, le développement et le soutien conceptuels dans la mise en œuvre du logiciel de contrôle et les essais sur les plateformes de simulation en temps réel

• Effectuer la mise en service, les essais et la formation des clients sur place

• Fournir un appui technique pendant l ' exécution du projet et après l ' exécution

• Soutenir l'équipe de vente dans la préparation des concepts techniques et de la documentation d'appel d'offres

• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de contrôle, de système et d'ingénierie mécanique ainsi qu'avec la gestion de projet

Vos antécédents

• Diplôme en génie électrique (maîtrise ou baccalauréat, d'une université ou d'une université des sciences appliquées)

• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle pertinente

• Une expérience pratique avec MATLAB / Simulink est essentielle, avec une programmation texte structurée et Hidraw comme avantage supplémentaire

• Connaissance approfondie du contrôle électronique des processus et de la puissance et de la conception des logiciels (p. ex. CLO, CLC, Protection, HMI)

• La connaissance des protocoles de communication industrielle (p. ex. CPVP, CEI 61850, CEI 60870-5-104, DNP3) est un plus

• L'expérience initiale en essais, en mise en service ou en ingénierie appliquée est un avantage

• Volonté de voyager à l'échelle mondiale pour des missions de mise en service (environ 20 % du temps de travail)

• Connaissance de l'anglais et de l'allemand

Plus sur nous

Nos pratiques de travail flexibles vous aident à optimiser la performance personnelle et commerciale tout en créant un environnement où tous les employés peuvent développer leurs compétences et croître.

En outre, vous pouvez vous attendre:

• Travaux sur les technologies de pointe dans l'électronique électrique

• Expérience pratique dans les projets internationaux et les applications réelles

• Une combinaison de travaux de simulation, d'ingénierie et de projets sur place

• Possibilité de devenir un expert technique dans une entreprise en développement rapide

• Collaboration au sein d'une équipe d'ingénierie internationale hautement qualifiée

jobs.title: Schichtleiter/in 80 - 100% (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position
In dieser verantwortungsvollen und dynamischen Rolle sind Sie für die Produktion während einer Schicht bei MICAFIL in Altstetten (ZH) verantwortlich und stellen sicher, dass wir unsere Wettbewerbsfähigkeit weiter stärken und unsere Schweizer Niederlassung entwickeln, um dem globalen Marktwachstum gerecht zu werden. Durch Ihre klare Kommunikation und offene Persönlichkeit entwickeln Sie die Teams und Prozesse kontinuierlich weiter. Mit strategischem Weitblick und technischem Know-how unterstützen Sie die Leiter der Produktionsteams und entwickeln nachhaltige Lösungen, welche die Qualität, Effizienz und Wettbewerbsfähigkeit auf die nächste Stufe heben. Wenn Sie eine Leidenschaft für Prozessoptimierung haben, bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft unseres Standortes massgeblich mitzugestalten.

Das können Sie bewirken

• Verantwortlich für ein Schichtteam im Produktionsumfeld, einschliesslich Ressourcenmanagement und Teamentwicklung in einem 3-Schicht-Betriebsmodell (direkte Führung, 10-15 FTE)

• Sicherstellung einer kontinuierlichen und hohen Produktionsleistung in enger Abstimmung mit den Fabrikplanern und dem Produktionsleiter

• Verantwortung innerhalb der Schicht für Sicherheit, Qualität und Produktivität

• Dokumentation der Schichtleistung und Übergabe an nachfolgende Schichten

• Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeiter in den Produktionsprozess

• Identifizierung sowie Integration neuer Technologien und bewährter Verfahren, um den kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozess (KVP) gemeinsam mit unserem Process Engineering Team voranzutreiben

• Reduzierung des Ausschusses auf ein Minimum

• Verbesserung und Schulung von Arbeits- & Wartungsanweisungen zur Sicherstellung des 3-Schicht-Betriebs

• Überwachung der wichtigsten Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) zur Erfolgsmessung und Rückmeldung an den Produktionsleiter

Das bringen Sie mit

• Technische Ausbildung und Weiterbildung (TS / HF) im Bereich Technik, Führung oder einem vergleichbaren Gebiet

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Produktion, idealerweise im Schichtbetrieb

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Lean Management, Six Sigma und anderen Methoden der Prozessoptimierung

• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz und datengestütztes Vorgehen bei der Entscheidungsfindung

• Ausgezeichnete Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Zeitmanagement, Kommunikation und Organisation sowie die Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Termine einzuhalten

• Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Eigenverantwortung

• Ein kollegiales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

• Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulla posizione
In questo ruolo responsabile e dinamico, sarete responsabili di un turno di produzione presso MICAFIL ad Altstetten (ZH), assicurandoci di continuare a rafforzare la nostra competitività e sviluppare la nostra filiale svizzera per soddisfare la crescita del mercato globale. Attraverso la vostra chiara comunicazione e la personalità aperta, sviluppate continuamente i team e i processi. Con la supervisione strategica e il know-how tecnico, supporterete i leader del team di produzione e svilupperete soluzioni sostenibili che assumono qualità, efficienza e competitività al livello successivo. Se avete una passione per l'ottimizzazione dei processi, vi offriamo la possibilità di modellare in modo significativo il futuro della nostra posizione.

Possono farlo.

• Responsabile per un team di turni nell'ambiente di produzione, tra cui la gestione delle risorse e lo sviluppo del team in un modello operativo a 3 turni (gestione diretta, 10-15 FTE)

• Garantire una produzione continua ed elevata in stretto coordinamento con i progettisti di fabbrica e il responsabile della produzione

• Responsabilità all'interno dello strato per sicurezza, qualità e produttività

• Documentazione delle prestazioni dello strato e trasferimento a strati successivi

• Sostegno alla formazione di nuovi dipendenti nel processo produttivo

• Identificare e integrare nuove tecnologie e le migliori pratiche per guidare il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP) insieme al nostro Team di Ingegneria dei Processi

• Riduzione del Comitato al minimo

• Miglioramento e formazione delle istruzioni di lavoro e manutenzione per garantire il funzionamento a 3 turni

• Indicatori di performance chiave di monitoraggio (KPI) per la misurazione del successo e il feedback al responsabile della produzione

Ecco cosa portano con loro.

• Istruzione e formazione tecnica (TS / HF) nel campo dell'ingegneria, della leadership o di un campo comparabile

• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale nella produzione, idealmente nel funzionamento a turni

• Conoscenza approfondita di Lean Management, Six Sigma e altri metodi di ottimizzazione dei processi

• Forti capacità di risoluzione dei problemi e processi decisionali basati sui dati

• Competenze eccellenti nella gestione del tempo, della comunicazione e dell'organizzazione, nonché la capacità di priorità e rispettare le scadenze

• Flusso in tedesco, l'inglese è un vantaggio

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

• Lavoro sicuro in una società orientata al futuro

• Varie attività con responsabilità personale

• Un team collegiale con brevi percorsi decisionali

• Condizioni di lavoro interessanti e opportunità di sviluppo
descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
In this responsible and dynamic role, you will be responsible for one shift of production at MICAFIL in Altstetten (ZH), ensuring that we continue to strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss subsidiary to meet global market growth. Through your clear communication and open personality, you continuously develop the teams and processes. With strategic foresight and technical know-how, you will support production team leaders and develop sustainable solutions that take quality, efficiency and competitiveness to the next level. If you have a passion for process optimization, we offer you the opportunity to significantly shape the future of our location.

They can do that.

• Responsible for a shift team in the production environment, including resource management and team development in a 3-shift operating model (direct management, 10-15 FTE)

• Ensuring a continuous and high production output in close coordination with the factory planners and the production manager

• Responsibility within the layer for safety, quality and productivity

• Documentation of layer performance and transfer to subsequent layers

• Support for the training of new employees in the production process

• Identify and integrate new technologies and best practices to drive the continuous improvement process (CIP) together with our Process Engineering Team

• Reduction of the Committee to a minimum

• Improvement and training of work & maintenance instructions to ensure 3-shift operation

• Monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for success measurement and feedback to the production manager

This is what they bring with them.

• Technical education and training (TS / HF) in the field of engineering, leadership or a comparable field

• Several years of professional experience in production, ideally in shift operation

• In-depth knowledge of Lean Management, Six Sigma and other process optimization methods

• Strong problem-solving skills and data-driven decision-making

• Excellent skills in time management, communication and organization, as well as the ability to prioritize and meet deadlines

• Flowing in German, English is an advantage

More about us

• Secure workplace in a future-oriented company

• Varied tasks with personal responsibility

• A collegial team with short decision paths

• Attractive employment conditions and development opportunities

jobs.title: Internship in Semiconductor Packaging 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

The Research Team Semiconductor Packaging and Reliability Engineering at our Swiss Power Grids Research Center is looking for an intern student with expertise in electrical engineering, physics, materials and analytical methods to contribute to the development of novel semiconductor power modules for e-mobility and grid applications. The intern will interact with a dynamic and multidisciplinary team that will supervise and guide the project. If you have a strong technical background, motivation to develop innovative solutions, and you are goal-oriented, this is your opportunity to contribute in building a stronger and more sustainable energy future. The duration of the internship is six months.

Your responsibilities

• Support technology development and research activities in the development of semiconductor power modules, i.e. process development and prototype manufacturing in a state-of-the-art cleanroom

• Perform accelerated lifetime testing, characterize modules before and after aging, supervise the test setup

• Perform first steps of the root cause analysis (X-ray, SAM, cross section etc.) and concisely document the test results

• Perform electromagnetic and thermal infinite element simulations to validate design features

• Create CAD designs of power modules in close collaboration with the team, find creative and efficient solutions to meet demanding and sometimes conflicting requirements

Your background

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated Industrial Engineer in our Production with a  high focus on Lean Production and  Process flow optimization to further develop our Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) production environment in Zurich. In this role, you will apply industrial engineering principles, automation, and digital manufacturing approaches to improve productivity, safety, quality, cost efficiency, and delivery performance in a high-variety, low-volume, engineering-to-order manufacturing environment.
You will play a key role in analyzing and improving complex GCB assembly, testing, material flow, and workstation concepts, while supporting the continuous development of a lean, digital, and future-ready factory.

How you'll make an impact

• Analyze current GCB production layouts, assembly workflows, testing processes, material flows, and operational procedures to identify improvement potential in efficiency, safety, quality, cost, and lead time, with a strong focus on automation and digitalization opportunities.

• Design and implement optimized production processes, workstation concepts, automation solutions, equipment utilization concepts, and improved material flow for GCB assembly and testing.

• Conduct time and motion studies, process mapping, value stream analysis, layout planning, capacity analysis, and bottleneck assessments to eliminate non-value-added activities and increase operational performance.

• Develop, standardize, and improve work instructions, standard operating procedures, manufacturing documentation, and digital shopfloor processes for GCB assembly, testing, and logistics operations.

• Evaluate, specify, and implement new manufacturing technologies such as automated handling systems, smart tools, digital work instructions, MES-related solutions, and data-driven improvement applications.

• Support industrialization activities, new product implementation, series ramp-ups, CAPEX initiatives, equipment procurement, PFMEA activities, and the introduction of new tools, jigs, fixtures, and testing equipment.

• Collaborate closely with production, testing, engineering, industrialization, quality, supply chain, planning, HSE, project management, and product management teams to ensure robust and sustainable process improvements.

• Lead and participate in continuous improvement initiatives, Lean Manufacturing projects, Kaizen activities, Six Sigma-related improvements, shopfloor optimization, and digital factory initiatives.

• Maintain and improve manufacturing master data, production standards, routing information, and KPI-based performance transparency to support efficient planning and execution.

• Contribute to the long-term development of the GCB factory by identifying future automation potential, improving ergonomics, strengthening safety, and enabling scalable production capabilities.

Your background

• Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Professional experience in industrial engineering, production engineering, automation, industrialization, or manufacturing process improvement is preferred.

• Strong understanding of process optimization, Lean Manufacturing, continuous improvement methods, Kaizen, Six Sigma, value stream mapping, time studies, and statistical process control.

• Experience in complex assembly environments, high-voltage products, electrical equipment manufacturing, engineering-to-order production, or high-variety/low-volume manufacturing is highly desirable.

• Good knowledge of workstation design, layout planning, tooling concepts, ergonomics, equipment specification, manufacturing documentation, and structured problem solving.

• Familiarity with SAP, MES, digital work instructions, data analysis tools, or production KPI dashboards is an advantage.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across operations, engineering, supply chain, quality, HSE, and project teams.

• Structured, analytical, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset with the ability to manage several improvement projects simultaneously.

• Business fluent in English and German.

More about us

Our Generator Circuit-Breaker business in Zurich is a technology leader with a state-of-the-art factory based on lean manufacturing, flow production, and continuous improvement. We offer you the opportunity to shape the future of GCB production by combining industrial engineering, automation, digitalization, process flow optimization, and operational excellence in a dynamic and technically demanding manufacturing environment.

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills, grow, and contribute to advancing a sustainable energy future.

• Guidare e partecipare a iniziative di miglioramento continuo, progetti di Lean Manufacturing, attività Kaizen, miglioramenti correlati a Six Sigma, ottimizzazione del piano di negozio e iniziative di fabbrica digitale.

• Mantenere e migliorare i dati master di produzione, gli standard di produzione, le informazioni di routing e la trasparenza delle prestazioni basata su KPI per supportare una pianificazione e l'esecuzione efficienti.

• Contribuisci allo sviluppo a lungo termine dello stabilimento GCB identificando il potenziale di automazione futuro, migliorando l'ergonomia, rafforzando la sicurezza e consentendo capacità di produzione scalabili.

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria dell'automazione, Ingegneria industriale, Ingegneria manifatturiera, Ingegneria meccanica, Ingegneria elettrica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

• È preferibile un'esperienza professionale nell'ingegneria industriale, nell'ingegneria produttiva, nell'automazione, nell'industrializzazione o nel miglioramento dei processi produttivi.

• Forte comprensione dell'ottimizzazione dei processi, Lean Manufacturing, metodi di miglioramento continuo, Kaizen, Six Sigma, mappatura del flusso di valore, studi di tempo e controllo dei processi statistici.

• L'esperienza in ambienti di assemblaggio complessi, prodotti ad alta tensione, produzione di apparecchiature elettriche, produzione di ingegneria all'ordine, o la produzione ad alta qualità/basso volume è altamente auspicabile.

• Buona conoscenza della progettazione delle stazioni di lavoro, pianificazione del layout, concetti di utensili, ergonomia, specificazione delle attrezzature, documentazione di produzione e risoluzione dei problemi strutturati.

• La familiarità con SAP, MES, istruzioni di lavoro digitali, strumenti di analisi dei dati o cruscotti KPI di produzione è un vantaggio.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione, collaborazione e gestione delle parti interessate, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente attraverso operazioni, ingegneria, supply chain, qualità, HSE e team di progetto.

• Mindset strutturato, analitico, pratico e orientato alla soluzione con la capacità di gestire contemporaneamente diversi progetti di miglioramento.

• Business fluente in inglese e tedesco.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Il nostro business Generator Circuit-Breaker a Zurigo è un leader tecnologico con una fabbrica all'avanguardia basata sulla produzione magra, la produzione di flusso e il miglioramento continuo. Vi offriamo l'opportunità di plasmare il futuro della produzione GCB combinando ingegneria industriale, automazione, digitalizzazione, ottimizzazione dei flussi di processo e eccellenza operativa in un ambiente di produzione dinamico e tecnicamente esigente.

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze, crescere e contribuire a promuovere un futuro energetico sostenibile.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Wir suchen einen hochmotivierten Wirtschaftsingenieur in unserer Produktion mit hohem Fokus auf Lean Production und Prozessflussoptimierung, um unsere Generator Circuit-Breaker (GCB) Produktionsumgebung in Zürich weiterzuentwickeln. In dieser Rolle wenden Sie Industrial Engineering-Prinzipien, Automatisierung und digitale Fertigungsansätze an, um Produktivität, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosteneffizienz und Lieferleistung in einer hochvarianten, kleinvolumigen Fertigungsumgebung zu verbessern.
Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Analyse und Verbesserung komplexer GCB-Montage-, Test-, Materialfluss- und Arbeitsplatzkonzepte und unterstützen gleichzeitig die kontinuierliche Entwicklung einer schlanken, digitalen und zukunftsfähigen Fabrik.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen werden

• Analysieren Sie aktuelle GCB-Produktionslayouts, Montage-Workflows, Testprozesse, Materialflüsse und Betriebsverfahren, um Verbesserungspotenziale in Bezug auf Effizienz, Sicherheit, Qualität, Kosten und Durchlaufzeit zu identifizieren, wobei der Schwerpunkt auf Automatisierungs- und Digitalisierungsmöglichkeiten liegt.

• Konzipieren und implementieren Sie optimierte Produktionsprozesse, Arbeitsplatzkonzepte, Automatisierungslösungen, Geräteauslastungskonzepte und einen verbesserten Materialfluss für die GCB-Montage und -Prüfung.

• Durchführung von Zeit- und Bewegungsstudien, Prozessabbildung, Wertstromanalyse, Layoutplanung, Kapazitätsanalyse und Engpassbewertungen, um nicht wertschöpfende Aktivitäten zu eliminieren und die Betriebsleistung zu erhöhen.

• Entwickeln, standardisieren und verbessern Sie Arbeitsanweisungen, Standardbetriebsverfahren, Fertigungsdokumentation und digitale Shopfloor-Prozesse für GCB-Montage-, Test- und Logistikvorgänge.

• Bewerten, spezifizieren und implementieren Sie neue Fertigungstechnologien wie automatisierte Handhabungssysteme, intelligente Werkzeuge, digitale Arbeitsanweisungen, MES-bezogene Lösungen und datengesteuerte Verbesserungsanwendungen.

• Unterstützen Sie Industrialisierungsaktivitäten, die Implementierung neuer Produkte, Serien-Ramp-ups, CAPEX-Initiativen, die Beschaffung von Ausrüstung, PFMEA-Aktivitäten und die Einführung neuer Werkzeuge, Vorrichtungen und Prüfgeräte.

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktions-, Test-, Engineering-, Industrialisierungs-, Qualitäts-, Lieferketten-, Planungs-, HSE-, Projektmanagement- und Produktmanagementteams, um robuste und nachhaltige Prozessverbesserungen zu gewährleisten.

• Führen und beteiligen Sie sich an kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsinitiativen, Lean Manufacturing-Projekten, Kaizen-Aktivitäten, Six Sigma-bezogenen Verbesserungen, Shopfloor-Optimierung und digitalen Fabrikinitiativen.

• Pflegen und verbessern Sie Fertigungsstammdaten, Produktionsstandards, Routinginformationen und KPI-basierte Leistungstransparenz, um eine effiziente Planung und Ausführung zu unterstützen.

• Tragen Sie zur langfristigen Entwicklung der GCB-Fabrik bei, indem Sie zukünftige Automatisierungspotenziale identifizieren, die Ergonomie verbessern, die Sicherheit erhöhen und skalierbare Produktionskapazitäten ermöglichen.

Dein Hintergrund

• Master-Abschluss in Automation Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.

• Berufserfahrung in der Industrietechnik, Produktionstechnik, Automatisierung, Industrialisierung oder Herstellungsprozessverbesserung wird bevorzugt.

• Starkes Verständnis für Prozessoptimierung, Lean Manufacturing, kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmethoden, Kaizen, Six Sigma, Value Stream Mapping, Zeitstudien und statistische Prozesskontrolle.

• Erfahrung in komplexen Montageumgebungen, Hochspannungsprodukten, Herstellung von Elektrogeräten, Auftragsfertigung oder Fertigung mit hoher Vielfalt / geringem Volumen ist sehr wünschenswert.

• Gute Kenntnisse der Arbeitsplatzgestaltung, Layoutplanung, Werkzeugkonzepte, Ergonomie, Gerätespezifikation, Fertigungsdokumentation und strukturierte Problemlösung.

• Die Vertrautheit mit SAP, MES, digitalen Arbeitsanweisungen, Datenanalysetools oder Produktions-KPI-Dashboards ist von Vorteil.

• Starke Kommunikation, Zusammenarbeit und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv über Operationen, Engineering, Supply Chain, Qualität, HSE und Projektteams zu arbeiten.

• Strukturierte, analytische, praktische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Verbesserungsprojekte gleichzeitig zu verwalten.

• Business fließend in Englisch und Deutsch.

Mehr über uns

Unser Generator Circuit-Breaker-Geschäft in Zürich ist ein Technologieführer mit einer hochmodernen Fabrik, die auf schlanker Fertigung, Durchflussproduktion und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung basiert. Wir bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, die Zukunft der GCB-Produktion durch die Kombination von Industrietechnik, Automatisierung, Digitalisierung, Prozessflussoptimierung und operativer Exzellenz in einer dynamischen und technisch anspruchsvollen Fertigungsumgebung zu gestalten.

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsweisen helfen Ihnen, die persönliche und geschäftliche Leistung zu optimieren und gleichzeitig ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln, wachsen und zur Förderung einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft beitragen können.
