Dans ce rôle, vous appliquerez les principes de l'ingénierie industrielle, l'automatisation et les approches de fabrication numérique pour améliorer la productivité, la sécurité, la qualité, le rapport coût-efficacité et les performances de livraison dans un environnement de fabrication à haute variété, à faible volume et à commande.
Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'analyse et l'amélioration des concepts complexes d'assemblage, de test, de flux de matériaux et de postes de travail, tout en soutenant le développement continu d'une usine maigre, numérique et prête à l'avenir.

jobs.title: Internship in Reliability Testing for SiC-based Power Semiconductors 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

The energy landscape is rapidly evolving, requiring increasingly complex and reliable power distribution systems. The growing integration of renewable energy sources and converter interfaces introduces new challenges for transmission and distribution operators. Silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors have matured significantly and offer superior electrical performance, making them highly attractive for power electronics applications. However, challenges related to the gate stack reliability of SiC MOSFETs must still be addressed to enable their widespread adoption. The Semiconductors Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team seeks an intern to support the development of an innovative test setup for reliability investigations. The setup targets threshold voltage stability of SiC MOSFETs under extensive cycling and accelerated aging conditions. The successful candidate will develop and monitor a real-time system for tracking device aging. Experiments are conducted on a double pulse tester with a half-bridge evaluation board rated at 3.3 kV and 150 A. The internship duration is six months.

How you'll make an impact

• Conduct measurement campaigns and data analysis based on the latest models available in literature

• Propose innovative solutions for gathering more insights from the experimental tests: creating sensors array prototypes and automated data collection software

• Optimize a half-bridge converter for long-term dynamic testing of SiC MOSFETs

• Upgrade test electronics and data acquisition software needed to run high-precision measurements for extended test time

• Document and communicate the solutions developed, to disseminate the gained knowledge within the research team, academic collaborators and the business unit of pertinence

Your background

• Currently pursuing a Masters degree in electronics engineering, materials engineering, physics or a related discipline (official enrolment is essential)

• Familiar with electrical measurements setup and with the design and construction of electronics systems. Previous experience with semiconductor physics and/or power devices is a strong plus

• Experience with LabView programming, and knowledge of programming languages (e.g. Python, C, Matlab)

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Good communication and technical writing skills

• Creative and able to work autonomously

More about us

We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

Silicon carburo (SiC) semiconduttori di potenza sono maturati in modo significativo e offrono prestazioni elettriche superiori, rendendoli altamente attraenti per le applicazioni di elettronica di potenza. Tuttavia, le sfide relative all'affidabilità dello stack di cancello di SiC MOSFETs devono ancora essere affrontate per consentire la loro adozione diffusa. Il team di ricerca di Semiconductors Packaging and Reliability Engineering cerca uno stagista per supportare lo sviluppo di un'innovativa configurazione di test per le indagini sull'affidabilità. La configurazione mira alla stabilità della tensione di soglia di SiC MOSFETs in condizioni di ciclismo e invecchiamento accelerato. Il candidato di successo svilupperà e monitorerà un sistema in tempo reale per il monitoraggio dell'invecchiamento del dispositivo. Gli esperimenti sono condotti su un tester a doppio impulso con una scheda di valutazione a mezzo ponte valutato a 3.3 kV e 150 A. La durata dello stage è di sei mesi.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

The energy landscape is rapidly evolving, requiring increasingly complex and reliable power distribution systems. The growing integration of renewable energy sources and converter interfaces introduces new challenges for transmission and distribution operators. Silicon carbide (SiC) power semiconductors have matured significantly and offer superior electrical performance, making them highly attractive for power electronics applications. However, challenges related to the gate stack reliability of SiC MOSFETs must still be addressed to enable their widespread adoption. The Semiconductors Packaging and Reliability Engineering research team seeks an intern to support the development of an innovative test setup for reliability investigations. The setup targets threshold voltage stability of SiC MOSFETs under extensive cycling and accelerated aging conditions. The successful candidate will develop and monitor a real-time system for tracking device aging. Experiments are conducted on a double pulse tester with a half-bridge evaluation board rated at 3.3 kV and 150 A. The internship duration is six months.

How you'll make an impact

• Conduct measurement campaigns and data analysis based on the latest models available in literature

• Propose innovative solutions for gathering more insights from the experimental tests: creating sensors array prototypes and automated data collection software

• Optimize a half-bridge converter for long-term dynamic testing of SiC MOSFETs

• Upgrade test electronics and data acquisition software needed to run high-precision measurements for extended test time

• Document and communicate the solutions developed, to disseminate the gained knowledge within the research team, academic collaborators and the business unit of pertinence

Your background

• Currently pursuing a Masters degree in electronics engineering, materials engineering, physics or a related discipline (official enrolment is essential)

• Familiar with electrical measurements setup and with the design and construction of electronics systems. Previous experience with semiconductor physics and/or power devices is a strong plus

• Experience with LabView programming, and knowledge of programming languages (e.g. Python, C, Matlab)

• Fluency in written and spoken English

• Good communication and technical writing skills

• Creative and able to work autonomously

More about us

We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work.

Allerdings müssen noch Herausforderungen im Zusammenhang mit der Gate-Stack-Zuverlässigkeit von SiC-MOSFETs angegangen werden, um ihre breite Akzeptanz zu ermöglichen. • Expérience de la programmation LabView et connaissance des langages de programmation (p. ex. Python, C, Matlab)

• Connaissance de l'anglais écrit et parlé

• Bonnes compétences en communication et écriture technique

• Créatif et capable de travailler de manière autonome

Plus sur nous

jobs.title: R&D Senior Software Developer (C++)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced R&D Software Developer focused on C++ application development to join our technology organization.

In this role, you will develop, high-performance, and secure software systems built with modern C++ (C++17/20), with a strong focus on real-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.

As an R&D Software Developer within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.
You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.

We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.

How you'll make an impact:

• Develop system design in areas like multithreading, synchronization, I/O, and latency requirements for real-time operation.
• Develop high-performance C++ cores to managed runtime services (.NET, RUST) with minimal latency overhead.
• Implement performance optimization and scalability: profile threading behavior, minimizing lock contention, reducing memory allocations in critical paths, and ensure predictable latency at scale.
• Maintain high code quality through code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to SOLID, KISS, DRY and industry best practices.
• Participate in system design, best practices and maintaining code quality in performance-critical sections.
• Participate in technical architecture reviews, design documentation, and roadmaps for feature development, refactoring initiatives, and legacy code modernization, collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transform requirements into clear architectural designs.
• Support strategic technology decisions on dependencies, build tooling, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices, maintain cross-platform support: drive modernization of build systems, ensure consistency across multiple deployment environments, and support Linux/Windows compatibility.
• Practical Linux development and deployment strategies.
• Contribute to achieving business goals by designing, developing, and delivering high-quality software solutions.
• Continuously enhance existing systems and contribute to the creation of new features.
• Work effectively within an agile environment, continually expanding your technical expertise and understanding of the business domain, actively participate in a cross-disciplinary team and contribute to shared objectives.
Your Background:

• University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
• 8+ years of experience in senior technical roles.
• Advanced proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20) with deep understanding of RAII, smart pointers, STL, concurrency, and memory management.
• Practical knowledge of C# development in plus.
• Strong experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real-time system design.
• Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross-platform development for Windows and Linux.
• Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture patterns.
• Demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low-latency systems.
• Understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
• Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
• Knowledge of non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
• Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring.
• Understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards.
• Experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU) in plus.
• Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) in plus.
• Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients.
• Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
• Effective team player with strong communication skills and willingness to learn.
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken).
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

• Partecipare alla progettazione del sistema, alle migliori pratiche e mantenere la qualità del codice nelle sezioni critiche alle prestazioni.
• Partecipare a revisioni di architettura tecnica, documentazione di progettazione e roadmap per lo sviluppo di funzionalità, le iniziative di refactoring e la modernizzazione del codice legacy, collaborare con l'ingegneria, il prodotto e gli stakeholder aziendali per trasformare i requisiti in progetti architettonici chiari.
• Sostenere le decisioni strategiche della tecnologia sulle dipendenze, costruire strumenti, gestione della dipendenza e garantire pratiche della supply chain del software, mantenere il supporto cross-platform: guidare l'ammodernamento dei sistemi di costruzione, garantire la coerenza tra più ambienti di distribuzione e supportare la compatibilità Linux/Windows.
• Pratiche strategie di sviluppo e di distribuzione Linux.
• Contribuisci al raggiungimento degli obiettivi aziendali progettando, sviluppando e fornendo soluzioni software di alta qualità.
• Migliorare costantemente i sistemi esistenti e contribuire alla creazione di nuove funzionalità.
• Lavorare efficacemente all'interno di un ambiente agile, espandendo continuamente le competenze tecniche e la comprensione del dominio aziendale, partecipa attivamente a un team interdisciplinare e contribuisce a obiettivi condivisi.
Il tuo sfondo:

• Laurea in informatica, ingegneria, o un campo tecnico correlato.
• 8+ anni di esperienza in ruoli tecnici senior.
• Proficienza avanzata nel C++ moderno (C++17/20) con profonda comprensione di RAII, puntatori intelligenti, STL, convalutazione e gestione della memoria.
• Conoscenza pratica dello sviluppo di C# in più.
• Forte esperienza con primitivi multithreading, sincronizzazione, asincrono I/O e progettazione di sistema in tempo reale.
• Proficienza con sistemi di costruzione (CMake, Visual Studio) e sviluppo cross-platform per Windows e Linux.
• Esperienza con tecnologie di containerizzazione (Docker, Kubernetes) e modelli di architettura microservices.
• Esperienza dimostrata con sistemi di profilazione, ottimizzazione e bassa latenza.
• Comprensione dei principi dell'architettura del software e progettazione sicura e scalabile del sistema.
• Eccellente capacità di problem solving e la capacità di affrontare complesse sfide tecniche.
• Buona comprensione delle tecniche di test unitari e di integrazione e dei quadri di prova.
• Conoscenza dei requisiti non funzionali (performance, scalabilità, sicurezza).
• Sistemi di sviluppo di esperienze pratiche per la gestione e il monitoraggio della rete elettrica.
• Comprensione delle operazioni della rete elettrica e degli standard applicabili.
• Esperienza con sistemi di automazione industriale (SCADA, IED, RTU) in più.
• Esperienza con protocolli e standard industriali (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) in più.
• Esperienza pratica che funziona direttamente con i clienti del settore della rete elettrica.

• Efficace giocatore di squadra con forti capacità di comunicazione e la volontà di imparare.

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

A Hitachi Energy, riconosciamo che il nostro popolo è al centro del nostro successo. Ci impegniamo a fornire un lavoro di supporto e inclusivo, premi competitivi e opportunità di crescita professionale e personale. descriptionByLocale.en:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced R&D Software Developer focused on C++ application development to join our technology organization.

In this role, you will develop, high-performance, and secure software systems built with modern C++ (C++17/20), with a strong focus on real-time behavior, reliability, and long product lifecycle support.

As an R&D Software Developer within the Grid Automation domain, you will help shape innovative solutions for the power systems of tomorrow.
You will work closely with global technology teams that bring niche expertise and cutting-edge capabilities. Your work will directly support the development of real-time software used in critical infrastructure worldwide software designed for long-term reliability, high efficiency, and uncompromising security.

We value diverse experience and fresh perspectives. Even if you do not meet every listed requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are excited to learn more about you and the unique strengths you can bring to our team.

How you'll make an impact:

• Develop system design in areas like multithreading, synchronization, I/O, and latency requirements for real-time operation.
• Develop high-performance C++ cores to managed runtime services (.NET, RUST) with minimal latency overhead.
• Implement performance optimization and scalability: profile threading behavior, minimizing lock contention, reducing memory allocations in critical paths, and ensure predictable latency at scale.
• Maintain high code quality through code reviews, unit testing, and adherence to SOLID, KISS, DRY and industry best practices.
• Participate in system design, best practices and maintaining code quality in performance-critical sections.
• Participate in technical architecture reviews, design documentation, and roadmaps for feature development, refactoring initiatives, and legacy code modernization, collaborate with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to transform requirements into clear architectural designs.
• Support strategic technology decisions on dependencies, build tooling, dependency management, and secure software supply chain practices, maintain cross-platform support: drive modernization of build systems, ensure consistency across multiple deployment environments, and support Linux/Windows compatibility.
• Practical Linux development and deployment strategies.
• Contribute to achieving business goals by designing, developing, and delivering high-quality software solutions.
• Continuously enhance existing systems and contribute to the creation of new features.
• Work effectively within an agile environment, continually expanding your technical expertise and understanding of the business domain, actively participate in a cross-disciplinary team and contribute to shared objectives.
Your Background:

• University degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field.
• 8+ years of experience in senior technical roles.
• Advanced proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20) with deep understanding of RAII, smart pointers, STL, concurrency, and memory management.
• Practical knowledge of C# development in plus.
• Strong experience with multithreading, synchronization primitives, asynchronous I/O and real-time system design.
• Proficiency with building systems (CMake, Visual Studio) and cross-platform development for Windows and Linux.
• Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and microservices architecture patterns.
• Demonstrated experience with performance profiling, optimization, and low-latency systems.
• Understanding of software architecture principles and secure, scalable system design.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to tackle complex technical challenges.
• Good understanding of unit and integration testing techniques and testing frameworks.
• Knowledge of non-functional requirements (performance, scalability, security).
• Practical experience developing systems for power grid management and monitoring.
• Understanding of power grid operations and applicable standards.
• Experience with industrial automation systems (SCADA, IED, RTU) in plus.
• Experience with industrial protocols and standards (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) in plus.
• Practical experience working directly with power grid industry clients.
• Proven ability to translate customer requirements into clear technical designs.
• Effective team player with strong communication skills and willingness to learn.
• Excellent command of English (written and spoken).
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.

Our benefits offering for this role generally includes:

• Private medical care and life insurance​

• Access to fitness and wellness programs​

• Access to benefits platform with discounts and perks​

• Employee Capital Plans (PPK)​

• Equipment for working from home or allowances for setting up a workplace at home​

• Spectacles and contact lenses allowance​

• Company events and team‑building activities​

• Psychological support program​

• Free parking available

You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Chance

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen R&D-Softwareentwickler, der sich auf die Entwicklung von C++-Anwendungen konzentriert, um unserer Technologieorganisation beizutreten.

In dieser Funktion entwickeln Sie leistungsstarke und sichere Softwaresysteme, die mit modernem C++ (C++17/20) erstellt wurden, mit einem starken Fokus auf Echtzeitverhalten, Zuverlässigkeit und langer Produktlebenszyklusunterstützung.

Als F&E-Softwareentwickler im Bereich Grid Automation gestalten Sie innovative Lösungen für die Energiesysteme von morgen mit.
Sie arbeiten eng mit globalen Technologieteams zusammen, die Nischenexpertise und hochmoderne Fähigkeiten mitbringen. Ihre Arbeit unterstützt direkt die Entwicklung von Echtzeit-Software, die in weltweiter kritischer Infrastruktur für langfristige Zuverlässigkeit, hohe Effizienz und kompromisslose Sicherheit verwendet wird.

Wir schätzen vielfältige Erfahrungen und frische Perspektiven. Auch wenn Sie nicht alle aufgeführten Anforderungen erfüllen, empfehlen wir Ihnen, sich zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns, mehr über Sie und die einzigartigen Stärken zu erfahren, die Sie in unser Team einbringen können.

Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen:

• Entwickeln Sie das Systemdesign in Bereichen wie Multithreading, Synchronisation, I/O und Latenzanforderungen für den Echtzeitbetrieb.
• Entwicklung leistungsstarker C++-Kerne für Managed Runtime Services (.NET, RUST) mit minimalem Latenzaufwand.
• Implementieren Sie Performance-Optimierung und Skalierbarkeit: Profil-Threading-Verhalten, Minimierung von Lock-Konflikten, Reduzierung von Speicherzuweisungen in kritischen Pfaden und Gewährleistung einer vorhersagbaren Latenz im Maßstab.
• Behalten Sie eine hohe Codequalität durch Code-Reviews, Unit-Tests und die Einhaltung von SOLID, KISS, DRY und Best Practices der Branche.
• Beteiligen Sie sich am Systemdesign, Best Practices und der Aufrechterhaltung der Codequalität in leistungskritischen Abschnitten.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an technischen Architekturprüfungen, Designdokumentationen und Roadmaps für Feature-Entwicklung, Refactoring-Initiativen und Legacy-Code-Modernisierung, arbeiten Sie mit Engineering-, Produkt- und Geschäftsbeteiligten zusammen, um Anforderungen in klare architektonische Entwürfe umzuwandeln.
• Unterstützen Sie strategische Technologieentscheidungen in Bezug auf Abhängigkeiten, Build-Tooling, Abhängigkeitsmanagement und sichere Software-Lieferkettenpraktiken, pflegen Sie die plattformübergreifende Unterstützung: Fahren Sie die Modernisierung von Build-Systemen voran, stellen Sie Konsistenz in mehreren Bereitstellungsumgebungen sicher und unterstützen Sie Linux / Windows-Kompatibilität.
• Praktische Linux-Entwicklungs- und Bereitstellungsstrategien.
• Tragen Sie zur Erreichung Ihrer Geschäftsziele bei, indem Sie hochwertige Softwarelösungen entwerfen, entwickeln und bereitstellen.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung bestehender Systeme und Beitrag zur Schaffung neuer Funktionen.
• Arbeiten Sie effektiv in einem agilen Umfeld, erweitern Sie kontinuierlich Ihre technische Expertise und Ihr Verständnis für den Geschäftsbereich, nehmen Sie aktiv an einem interdisziplinären Team teil und tragen Sie zu gemeinsamen Zielen bei.
Ihr Hintergrund:

• Universitätsabschluss in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich.
• 8+ Jahre Erfahrung in leitenden technischen Rollen.
• Fortgeschrittene Kenntnisse im modernen C++ (C++17/20) mit tiefem Verständnis von RAII, Smart Pointern, STL, Parallelität und Speicherverwaltung.
• Praktische Kenntnisse der C # -Entwicklung in Plus.
• Starke Erfahrung mit Multithreading, Synchronisationsprimitiven, asynchronem I/O und Echtzeit-Systemdesign.
• Kenntnisse in Gebäudesystemen (CMake, Visual Studio) und plattformübergreifender Entwicklung für Windows und Linux.
• Erfahrung mit Containerisierungstechnologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und Microservices-Architekturmustern.
• Demonstrierte Erfahrung mit Performance-Profiling, Optimierung und Systemen mit niedriger Latenz.
• Verständnis der Prinzipien der Softwarearchitektur und des sicheren, skalierbaren Systemdesigns.
• Hervorragende Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Herausforderungen zu bewältigen.
• Gutes Verständnis von Unit- und Integrationstesttechniken und Testframeworks.
• Kenntnis nicht-funktionaler Anforderungen (Leistung, Skalierbarkeit, Sicherheit).
• Praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Systemen zur Verwaltung und Überwachung von Stromnetzen.
• Verständnis des Stromnetzbetriebs und der geltenden Standards.
• Erfahrung mit industriellen Automatisierungssystemen (SCADA, IED, RTU) in plus.
• Erfahrung mit industriellen Protokollen und Standards (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) plus.
• Praktische Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden der Stromnetzbranche.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Kundenanforderungen in klare technische Designs zu übersetzen.
• Effektiver Teamplayer mit starken Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Lernbereitschaft.
• Ausgezeichnete Englischkenntnisse (geschrieben und gesprochen).
Mehr über uns

Bei Hitachi Energy erkennen wir, dass unsere Mitarbeiter im Mittelpunkt unseres Erfolgs stehen. Wir verpflichten uns, einen unterstützenden und integrativen Arbeitsplatz, wettbewerbsfähige Belohnungen und Möglichkeiten für berufliches und persönliches Wachstum zu bieten. Unser Leistungspaket wurde entwickelt, um Mitarbeitern zu helfen, sowohl bei der Arbeit als auch in ihrem persönlichen Leben erfolgreich zu sein.

Unser Leistungsangebot für diese Rolle umfasst im Allgemeinen:

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité

Nous recherchons un développeur de logiciels de R & D expérimenté axé sur le développement d'applications C++ pour rejoindre notre organisation technologique.

Dans ce rôle, vous développerez, des systèmes logiciels performants et sécurisés construits avec le C++ moderne (C++17/20), en mettant fortement l'accent sur le comportement en temps réel, la fiabilité et la longue durée de vie des produits.

En tant que développeur logiciel de R & D dans le domaine de l'automatisation du réseau, vous aiderez à façonner des solutions innovantes pour les systèmes d'alimentation de demain.
Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des équipes technologiques mondiales qui apportent une expertise de niche et des capacités de pointe. Votre travail soutiendra directement le développement de logiciels en temps réel utilisés dans les infrastructures critiques dans le monde entier, conçus pour une fiabilité à long terme, une efficacité élevée et une sécurité sans compromis.

Nous apprécions l'expérience diversifiée et les nouvelles perspectives. Même si vous ne respectez pas toutes les exigences énumérées, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Nous sommes heureux d'en apprendre plus sur vous et les forces uniques que vous pouvez apporter à notre équipe.

Comment vous ferez un impact:

• Développer la conception de systèmes dans des domaines comme le multithreading, la synchronisation, les E/S et les exigences de latence pour le fonctionnement en temps réel.
• Développez des cœurs C++ haute performance pour des services d'exécution gérés (.NET, ROUST) avec un minimum de frais généraux de latence.
• Implémenter l'optimisation des performances et l'évolutivité : comportement de filetage de profil, minimiser la discorde de verrouillage, réduire les allocations de mémoire dans les chemins critiques, et assurer une latence prévisible à l'échelle.
• Maintenir une qualité de code élevée au moyen d'examens de code, de tests unitaires et de l'adhésion aux pratiques exemplaires de SOLID, KISS, DRY et de l'industrie.
• Participer à la conception des systèmes, aux pratiques exemplaires et au maintien de la qualité des codes dans les sections essentielles au rendement.
• Participer à l'examen de l'architecture technique, à la documentation de conception et aux feuilles de route pour l'élaboration de caractéristiques, les initiatives de refactoration et la modernisation du code hérité, collaborer avec les intervenants du génie, des produits et des entreprises pour transformer les exigences en conceptions architecturales claires.
• Soutenir les décisions technologiques stratégiques sur les dépendances, construire des outils, gérer la dépendance et sécuriser les pratiques de la chaîne d'approvisionnement des logiciels, maintenir un support multiplateforme : piloter la modernisation des systèmes de construction, assurer la cohérence entre plusieurs environnements de déploiement et soutenir la compatibilité Linux/Windows.
• Stratégies pratiques de développement et de déploiement Linux.
• Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs opérationnels en concevant, développant et fournissant des solutions logicielles de haute qualité.
• Améliorer continuellement les systèmes existants et contribuer à la création de nouvelles fonctionnalités.
• Travailler efficacement dans un environnement agile, développer continuellement votre expertise technique et votre compréhension du domaine des affaires, participer activement à une équipe interdisciplinaire et contribuer à des objectifs communs.
Contexte :

• Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en génie ou dans un domaine technique connexe.
• 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans les rôles techniques supérieurs.
• Compétences avancées en C++ moderne (C++17/20) avec une compréhension approfondie de RAII, pointeurs intelligents, STL, concurrence et gestion de la mémoire.
• Connaissance pratique du développement C# en plus.
• Forte expérience avec le multithreading, la synchronisation primitive, les E/S asynchrones et la conception en temps réel du système.
• Compétence avec les systèmes de construction (CMake, Visual Studio) et développement multiplateforme pour Windows et Linux.
• Expérience des technologies de conteneurisation (Docker, Kubernetes) et des modèles d'architecture de microservices.
• Expérience démontrée avec les systèmes de profilage des performances, d'optimisation et de faible latence.
• Compréhension des principes d'architecture logicielle et conception sécurisée et évolutive du système.
• Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes et capacité à relever des défis techniques complexes.
• Bonne compréhension des techniques d'essai de l'unité et de l'intégration et des cadres d'essai.
• Connaissance des exigences non fonctionnelles (performance, évolutivité, sécurité).
• Expérience pratique du développement de systèmes de gestion et de surveillance du réseau électrique.
• Compréhension des opérations du réseau électrique et des normes applicables.
• Expérience des systèmes d'automatisation industrielle (SCADA, IED, RTU) en plus.
• Expérience des protocoles et des normes industriels (IEC-60870-5-104, DNP3, OPC UA, IEEE C37.118) en plus.
• Expérience pratique en travaillant directement avec les clients du secteur du réseau électrique.
• Capacité éprouvée de traduire les exigences du client en conceptions techniques claires.
• Joueur d'équipe efficace avec de solides compétences de communication et la volonté d'apprendre.
• Excellente maîtrise de l'anglais (écrit et parlé).
Plus sur nous

Chez Hitachi Energy, nous reconnaissons que notre peuple est au cœur de notre succès. Nous sommes déterminés à offrir un milieu de travail favorable et inclusif, des récompenses concurrentielles et des possibilités de croissance professionnelle et personnelle. jobs.title: Facility Technician – Chemical Utilities 80–100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our facilities and infrastructure team as a Facility Technician – Chemical Utilities, where you will play a key role in ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of critical utility systems supporting production activities. This is an excellent opportunity for a technically skilled professional to contribute to operational excellence, infrastructure projects, and continuous improvement initiatives within a highly regulated industrial environment.

Your responsibilities

• Operate, maintain, and repair utility systems, including process gas, ultrapure water, chemical supply, wastewater treatment, and cooling water systems

• Troubleshoot equipment failures and implement corrective and continuous improvement measures

• Execute and document maintenance activities and manage spare parts through the maintenance management system

• Support the operation and upkeep of site-wide infrastructure across multiple technical disciplines

• Coordinate logistics activities related to the procurement, handling, replacement, and disposal of chemicals and gases

• Monitor and ensure compliance with operational specifications, safety standards, and regulatory requirements

• Operate building management systems, fire alarm systems, gas detection systems, and other safety-critical equipment

• Support infrastructure projects, commissioning activities, and KPI reporting related to maintenance, costs, projects, and budgets

• Ensuring uninterrupted production operations around the clock (24/7) as well as the willingness to perform on-call duty

Your background

• Completed technical apprenticeship or vocational training, preferably in Chemical Engineering, Process Technology, Facility Management, or a related field

• Experience in the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of industrial utility or infrastructure systems

• Knowledge of process engineering and industrial plant operations

• Basic understanding of electrical, mechanical, instrumentation, and control systems

• Experience working with maintenance management systems and Microsoft Office applications

• Knowledge of occupational health and safety, environmental protection, and relevant regulatory requirement

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills with a hands-on mindset.

• Reliable team player with a structured work approach, high safety awareness, and strong communication skills

More about us

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

titleByLocale.fr: Technicien de la Facilité – Utilités Chimiques 80–100% (f/m/d)

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità

Unisciti al nostro team di strutture e infrastrutture come Facility Technician – Chemical Utilities, dove svolgerai un ruolo chiave nel garantire il funzionamento sicuro, affidabile ed efficiente dei sistemi di utilità critici che supportano le attività di produzione. • Eseguire e documentare le attività di manutenzione e gestire i pezzi di ricambio attraverso il sistema di manutenzione

• Coordinare le attività logistiche relative all'approvvigionamento, gestione, sostituzione e smaltimento di prodotti chimici e gas

• Monitorare e garantire la conformità alle specifiche operative, agli standard di sicurezza e ai requisiti normativi

• Operare sistemi di gestione dell'edificio, sistemi di allarme antincendio, sistemi di rilevamento del gas e altre attrezzature critiche alla sicurezza

• Supporta progetti infrastrutturali, attività di messa in servizio e report KPI relativi a manutenzione, costi, progetti e budget

• Esperienza nel funzionamento, manutenzione e risoluzione dei problemi dei sistemi di utilità industriale o infrastruttura

• Conoscenza dell'ingegneria dei processi e delle operazioni di impianti industriali

• Comprensione di base dei sistemi elettrici, meccanici, strumentali e di controllo

• Esperienza di lavoro con sistemi di gestione della manutenzione e applicazioni Microsoft Office

• Conoscenza della salute e della sicurezza sul lavoro, della protezione dell'ambiente e dei requisiti normativi rilevanti

• Forte analitica, problem solving, e la risoluzione dei problemi con una mentalità hands-on.

• Affidabile giocatore di squadra con un approccio di lavoro strutturato, alta consapevolezza della sicurezza e forti capacità di comunicazione

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer or Technician - Diffusion 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As a Diffusion Maintenance Engineer/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of diffusion equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line.

How you'll make an impact

• Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of diffusion equipment

• Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology

• Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency

• Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability

• Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance

• Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team

• Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of diffusion, safety, and best maintenance practices

• Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations

Your background

• Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools

• Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics

• Experience with diffusion systems (e.g. ASM, centrotherm ovens)

• Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (e.g., Surfscan, Semilab WT-2000)

• Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies

• Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field)

• Willingness to work in shifts is a must

• Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus)

More about us

Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

jobs.description:
Über die Position
Als Wartungs- und Instandhaltungstechniker/in stellst du die hohe Verfügbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Betriebssicherheit unserer Produktionsanlagen, Automatisierungssysteme und technischen Infrastrukturen am Standort Wettingen sicher. Du unterstützt die Produktion durch professionelle Störungsbehebung, präventive Instandhaltung und technische Optimierungen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, unsere Anlagen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und unsere Produktionsprozesse effizienter und zuverlässiger zu gestalten.

Das kannst du bewirken

• Sicherstellung eines zuverlässigen Betriebs unserer Produktionsanlagen, Automatisierungssysteme und technischen Infrastruktur sowie Durchführung von Anlageninspektionen und Zustandsbewertungen

• Analyse und Behebung von mechanischen, elektrischen, pneumatischen und automatisierungstechnischen Störungen inklusive Ursachenanalysen und nachhaltiger Umsetzung von Korrekturmassnahmen

• Durchführung präventiver Wartungs- und Inspektionsarbeiten gemäss Wartungsplänen sowie kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Wartungsstandards und Instandhaltungsprozessen

• Unterstützung der Produktion bei technischen Problemen sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung technischer Standards, Qualitätsanforderungen und Sicherheitsvorgaben

• Identifikation und Umsetzung technischer Verbesserungen zur Steigerung von Anlagenverfügbarkeit, Produktivität und Qualität sowie Mitarbeit bei Lean-, TPM- und Operational-Excellence-Initiativen

• Unterstützung bei Anlagenoptimierungen, Umbauten, Modernisierungen und technischen Investitionsprojekten

• Mitarbeit bei der Verwaltung kritischer Ersatzteile sowie Sicherstellung der technischen Verfügbarkeit notwendiger Komponenten

• Dokumentation von Störungen, Wartungsarbeiten und Verbesserungsmassnahmen im Instandhaltungssystem sowie Einhaltung von Sicherheits- und Compliance-Vorgaben

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung als Automatiker/in, Mechatroniker/in, Polymechaniker/in, Elektromechaniker/in oder eine vergleichbare technische Ausbildung

• Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung industrieller Produktionsanlagen sowie Kenntnisse in Mechanik, Pneumatik, Elektrotechnik und Automatisierung

• Kenntnisse in SPS-Steuerungen, Robotik und industriellen Automatisierungssystemen von Vorteil

• Erfahrung mit SAP PM, Instandhaltungsmanagementsystemen oder vergleichbaren Tools sowie Verständnis für TPM-, Lean- und Operational-Excellence-Methoden

• Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hoher Problemlösungskompetenz und ausgeprägtem Sicherheitsbewusstsein

• Teamfähigkeit, Serviceorientierung sowie Bereitschaft zur Mitarbeit im Schichtbetrieb und Pikettdienst

Mehr über uns
Hitachi Energy gestaltet die Energiezukunft mit innovativen Technologien für eine nachhaltige und zuverlässige Energieversorgung. Bei uns erwartet dich ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, ein starkes Team und die Möglichkeit, aktiv an zukunftsorientierten Lösungen mitzuwirken.

Sulla posizione
In qualità di tecnico di manutenzione e manutenzione, garantisci l'elevata disponibilità, affidabilità e affidabilità operativa dei nostri impianti di produzione, sistemi di automazione e infrastrutture tecniche presso il sito Wettingen. descriptionByLocale.en:
About the position
As a maintenance and maintenance technician, you ensure the high availability, reliability and operational reliability of our production facilities, automation systems and technical infrastructures at the Wettingen site. You support production through professional troubleshooting, preventive maintenance and technical optimizations. In doing so, you work closely with different specialist areas and actively contribute to the continuous development of our plants and to make our production processes more efficient and reliable.

You can do that.

• Ensuring reliable operation of our production facilities, automation systems and technical infrastructure as well as carrying out plant inspections and condition assessments

• Analysis and correction of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic and automation malfunctions including root cause analysis and sustainable implementation of corrective measures

• Implementation of preventive maintenance and inspection work according to maintenance plans as well as continuous improvement of maintenance standards and maintenance processes

• Supporting production in the event of technical problems and ensuring compliance with technical standards, quality requirements and safety requirements

• Identification and implementation of technical improvements to increase plant availability, productivity and quality as well as participation in lean, TPM and operational excellence initiatives

• Support for plant optimisation, conversion, modernisation and technical investment projects

• Cooperation in the management of critical spare parts and ensuring the technical availability of necessary components

• Documentation of faults, maintenance work and improvement measures in the maintenance system as well as compliance with safety and compliance requirements

You bring that with you

• Completed technical vocational training as an automatic, mechatronic, polymechanic, electromechanic or equivalent technical training

• Experience in maintenance of industrial production facilities and knowledge of mechanics, pneumatics, electrical engineering and automation

• Knowledge of PLC controls, robotics and industrial automation systems is advantageous

• Experience with SAP PM, maintenance management systems or similar tools as well as an understanding of TPM, lean and operational excellence methods

• Structured, analytical and solution-oriented working method with high problem-solving competence and strong security awareness

• Teamwork, service orientation and willingness to cooperate in shift operations and pikett service

More about us
Hitachi Energy is shaping the energy future with innovative technologies for a sustainable and reliable energy supply. With us, you can expect a modern working environment, a strong team and the opportunity to actively participate in future-oriented solutions.

jobs.title: Global AI Prompting Engineer PGTR
jobs.description:
The opportunity
As part of our ongoing digital transformation journey, we are developing ACE, a cutting-edge Generative AI-powered platform designed to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of our Bid & Proposal Management process within the Transformers Business Unit. We are seeking a Prompt Engineer who will play a pivotal role in this initiative. This individual will be responsible for designing, testing, and optimizing domain-specific prompts that enable ACE to generate accurate, context-aware, and business-aligned outputs.
The role requires a deep understanding of transformer industry, industrial equipment standards as well as basic understanding of prompt engineering best practices and GenAI model behavior, ensuring that ACE delivers high-quality responses tailored to complex business scenarios. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with IT Experts, Subject Matter Experts, Business stakeholders, and Module Owners to break down complex business logic into domain-specific prompts.

How you'll make an impact

• Develop, refine, and maintain prompt libraries for various transformer units/factories.
• Implement advanced techniques like prompt chaining, context injection, and few-shot learning for enterprise-grade accuracy.
• Own prompt lifecycle management including versioning, traceability, and governance.
• Evaluate LLM responses for precision, compliance, and bias mitigation.
• Conduct A/B testing and maintain performance dashboards for prompt effectiveness.
• Work closely with Module Owners, Subject Matter Experts, and Business Stakeholders to embed prompts into ACE workflows.
• Create clear documentation for prompt strategies and maintain best practices aligned with Hitachi Energy's AI Ethics Charter.
• Stay updated on emerging GenAI technologies, frameworks, and tools to enhance ACE capabilities.
• Implement and recommend best practices for prompting across different ACE modules.
Your background

• Bachelor or master degree in electrical engineering
• Experience working in the transformer industry, with international standards and customer documentation.
• Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
• Strong linguistic and logical reasoning for crafting precise prompts.
• Strong understanding of NLP, context management, and token optimization.
• Ability to experiment and iterate to optimize outputs.
• Ability to understand business processes and translate them into ACE-specific prompts.
• Hands-on experience with LLMs and prompt engineering techniques.
• Strong interest in AI enterprise-grade solutions.
• Willingness to learn Python and experience with AI APIs services.
• Ability to work in Agile environments and manage multiple stakeholders.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
• Analytical mindset with attention to detail.
• Empathy for end users and curiosity for experimentation.
• Commitment to ethical AI practices and continuous learning.
• Reduction in prompt failure rate and model hallucination.
• Improvement in accuracy of outputs by modules.
• Speed and scalability of prompt deployment across ACE modules within the Transformer Business Unit.
• Compliance with AI governance and security standards.
More about us

At Hitachi Energy, we recognize that our people are at the heart of our success. We are committed to providing a supportive and inclusive workplace, competitive rewards, and opportunities for professional and personal growth. Our benefits package is designed to help employees thrive both at work and in their personal lives.
Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes:​

• Competitive salary and incentives​
• Well-being and care ​
• Paid and unpaid leave​
• Flexible work options ​
• Benefits that support your financial security​You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'opportunità
Nell'ambito del nostro continuo viaggio di trasformazione digitale, stiamo sviluppando ACE, una piattaforma generativa AI all'avanguardia progettata per migliorare l'efficienza e l'accuratezza del nostro processo di Bid & Propost Management all'interno della Transformers Business Unit. Stiamo cercando un Prompt Engineer che svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale in questa iniziativa. Questo individuo sarà responsabile per la progettazione, il test e l'ottimizzazione dei prompt specifici di dominio che consentono ACE di generare output accurati, contestuali e business-aligned.
Il ruolo richiede una profonda comprensione dell'industria dei trasformatori, degli standard di attrezzature industriali e della comprensione di base delle migliori pratiche ingegneristiche e del comportamento del modello GenAI, assicurando che ACE offra risposte di alta qualità su misura per scenari aziendali complessi. Il candidato ideale collaborerà a stretto contatto con gli esperti IT, gli esperti di materia principale, le parti interessate di business e i proprietari di moduli per abbattere la logica aziendale complessa in richieste specifiche di dominio.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Sviluppare, affinare e mantenere librerie rapide per diverse unità/fattori di trasformatori.
• Implementare tecniche avanzate come la catena rapida, l'iniezione di contesto, e l'apprendimento di pochi colpi per la precisione di livello enterprise.
• Gestione del proprio ciclo di vita rapido tra cui la versione, tracciabilità e governance.
• Valuta le risposte LLM per la mitigazione di precisione, conformità e bias.
• Condurre test A/B e mantenere le dashboard delle prestazioni per una rapida efficacia.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con i proprietari di moduli, gli esperti di materia principale del soggetto e gli stakeholder aziendali per incorporare i suggerimenti nei flussi di lavoro ACE.
• Creare documentazione chiara per le strategie rapide e mantenere le migliori pratiche allineate con la Carta Etica AI di Hitachi Energy.
• Resta aggiornato sulle tecnologie, i framework e gli strumenti emergenti di GenAI per migliorare le capacità ACE.
• Implementare e consigliare le migliori pratiche per richiedere diversi moduli ACE.
Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea o master in ingegneria elettrica
• Esperienza nel settore dei trasformatori, con standard internazionali e documentazione dei clienti.
• Forte problem-solving e pensiero analitico.
• Forte ragionamento linguistico e logico per la realizzazione di precisi suggerimenti.
• Forte comprensione di NLP, gestione del contesto e ottimizzazione dei token.
• Capacità di sperimentare e iterare per ottimizzare gli output.
• Capacità di comprendere i processi aziendali e tradurli in richieste specifiche ACE.
• Esperienza pratica con LLM e tecniche ingegneristiche rapide.
• Forte interesse per le soluzioni aziendali AI.
• Volontà di imparare Python ed esperienza con i servizi AI APIs.
• Capacità di lavorare in ambienti Agile e gestire più stakeholder.
• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione.
• Mindset analitico con attenzione ai dettagli.
• Empatia per gli utenti finali e curiosità per la sperimentazione.
• Impegno alle pratiche etiche dell'IA e all'apprendimento continuo.
• Riduzione del tasso di guasto rapido e allucinazione del modello.
• Miglioramento della precisione delle uscite per moduli.
• Velocità e scalabilità dell'implementazione rapida tra i moduli ACE all'interno del Transformer Business Unit.
• Rispetto degli standard di governance e sicurezza AI.
Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

A Hitachi Energy, riconosciamo che il nostro popolo è al centro del nostro successo. Ci impegniamo a fornire un lavoro di supporto e inclusivo, premi competitivi e opportunità di crescita professionale e personale. Il nostro pacchetto benefici è progettato per aiutare i dipendenti a prosperare sia al lavoro che nella loro vita personale.
La nostra offerta di benefici è su misura in base al vostro paese di lavoro e in genere include:

• Competitività e incentivi
• Benessere e cura
• congedo pagato e non pagato
• Opzioni di lavoro flessibili
• Vantaggi che supportano la sicurezza finanziaria Riceverai informazioni più specifiche durante il processo di reclutamento.

• Starkes Interesse an KI Enterprise-Grade-Lösungen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'opportunité
Dans le cadre de notre parcours de transformation numérique en cours, nous développons ACE, une plate-forme de pointe à moteur d'IA, conçue pour améliorer l'efficacité et l'exactitude de notre processus de gestion des soumissions et des propositions au sein de l'unité opérationnelle Transformers. Nous cherchons un ingénieur prompt qui jouera un rôle central dans cette initiative. Cette personne sera responsable de la conception, de l'essai et de l'optimisation d'invites spécifiques au domaine qui permettent à ACE de générer des extrants précis, adaptés au contexte et adaptés aux activités.
Le rôle exige une compréhension approfondie de l'industrie des transformateurs, des normes d'équipement industriel ainsi qu'une compréhension de base des meilleures pratiques d'ingénierie rapides et du comportement du modèle GenAI, garantissant qu'ACE offre des réponses de haute qualité adaptées à des scénarios d'affaires complexes. Le candidat idéal collaborera étroitement avec les experts en TI, les experts en la matière, les intervenants en affaires et les propriétaires de modules pour ventiler la logique d'affaires complexe en indicateurs spécifiques au domaine.

Comment vous ferez un impact

• Développer, affiner et maintenir des bibliothèques rapides pour diverses unités/usines de transformateurs.
• Mettre en œuvre des techniques avancées comme l'enchaînement rapide, l'injection contextuelle et l'apprentissage à petite échelle pour la précision de l'entreprise.
• Gestion rapide du cycle de vie, y compris la version, la traçabilité et la gouvernance.
• Évaluer les réponses à la LLM pour déterminer la précision, la conformité et l'atténuation des biais.
• Effectuer des essais A/B et maintenir les tableaux de bord de performance pour une efficacité rapide.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les propriétaires de modules, les experts en la matière et les intervenants d'affaires pour intégrer les invites dans les workflows ACE.
• Créer une documentation claire pour des stratégies rapides et maintenir les meilleures pratiques conformes à la Charte d'éthique de l'IA d'Hitachi Energy.

• Mettre en œuvre et recommander des pratiques exemplaires pour inciter les participants à participer à différents modules de l'ACE.
Vos antécédents

• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en génie électrique
• Expérience de travail dans l'industrie des transformateurs, avec des normes internationales et la documentation client.
• Forte résolution de problèmes et réflexion analytique.
• Un raisonnement linguistique et logique fort pour élaborer des instructions précises.
• Une bonne compréhension du NLP, de la gestion du contexte et de l'optimisation des jetons.

• Expérience pratique des LLM et des techniques d'ingénierie rapides.
• Intérêt pour les solutions de qualité d'entreprise AI.
• Volonté d'apprendre Python et expérience avec les services API AI.
• Capacité de travailler dans des environnements agiles et de gérer plusieurs intervenants.
• Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration.
• Un état d'esprit analytique avec attention au détail.
• Empathie pour les utilisateurs finaux et curiosité pour l'expérimentation.
• Engagement envers les pratiques éthiques en matière d'IA et l'apprentissage continu.
• Réduction du taux de défaillance rapide et hallucination modèle.
• Amélioration de la précision des produits par modules.

jobs.description:
Über die Position
Als Teamleiter/in Elektromontage in der GI Valves Fabrik in Seon bzw. Turgi leitest Du ein Team von ca. 15 Mitarbeitenden. Dabei übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in der täglichen Produktionssteuerung. Du koordinierst operative Tätigkeiten innerhalb des Teams und sorgst dafür, dass Montage-, Prüf- und Logistikprozesse effizient, sicher und qualitätsgerecht ablaufen. Dabei bist Du die direkte Ansprechperson für die Mitarbeitenden und arbeitest eng mit der Produktionsleitung und anderen Schnittstellen zusammen. Dein Einsatz trägt wesentlich dazu bei, dass wir unsere Produktionsziele erreichen und uns kontinuierlich verbessern. Neben koordinativen Tätigkeiten arbeitest Du aktiv im Montageprozess mit (ca. 50%).

Das kannst du bewirken

• Leitung des Teams sowohl fachlich und operativ als auch personell

• Organisation und Überwachung der Produktionsabläufe (Montage, Prüfung, Logistik)

• Einhaltung von Sicherheits-, Qualitäts- und Umweltvorgaben

• Unterstützung bei der Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und Durchführung von Sicherheitsunterweisungen

• Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Planung, Qualität und Logistik sowie Dokumentation der Produktionsleistung

• Umsetzung und Durchsetzung der übergeordneten Organisationsziele

Das bringst du mit

• Technische Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektrotechnik, Elektroinstallation, Mechatronik)

• Erfahrung als Teamleiter/in und gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten

• Deutsch in Wort und Schrift, Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

Unsere flexiblen Arbeitsmethoden helfen dir, deine persönlichen und beruflichen Leistungen zu optimieren, und schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem alle Mitarbeiter ihre Fähigkeiten entwickeln und wachsen können.

jobs.title: Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is seeking a Senior R&D Mechanical Engineer – High Voltage to join our innovative and forward-thinking team. In this role, you will take on significant responsibility for the development and delivery of innovative products and technologies. You will leverage your technical expertise to lead key aspects of projects, ensuring that solutions meet the highest standards of quality and performance while adhering to strict deadlines and budgets. This is a high-impact role with excellent opportunities for career growth and development.

How you will make an impact

• Apply your expertise in technologies, tools, and methods to solve complex industrial challenges and develop innovative products and solutions

• Contribute to shaping technology strategies and project portfolios, helping guide the direction of the organization

• Work on complex engineering tasks using advanced and innovative techniques to deliver impactful R&D results

• Take on project leadership responsibilities or play a key role within project teams, while supporting and mentoring junior colleagues

• Stay up to date with key trends and technologies in your field and proactively drive improvements in operations and customer satisfaction

• Act as a subject matter expert, supporting colleagues and sharing knowledge to foster collaboration and innovation within the team

• Support business operations and customers as a technical expert and represent the team in internal and external engineering forums

• Contribute to intellectual property strategy, identify risks, and support effective risk management in R&D projects

Your background

• Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Physics, or a related field

• 5–10 years of experience in R&D or engineering, preferably in high voltage equipment or components

• Strong expertise in the design and development of high voltage components (experience with bushings is an advantage)

• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken

• Solid understanding of business processes and R&D environments

• Proven experience in project management and cross-functional collaboration

• Basic understanding of intellectual property considerations in R&D

More about us
 At Hitachi Energy, you will work in an international and collaborative environment, contributing to innovative technologies that shape the future of energy systems.
This role offers the opportunity to address real-world challenges in power grids and sustainability, combining advanced engineering with impactful applications.
Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

• Applica la tua esperienza in tecnologie, strumenti e metodi per risolvere complesse sfide industriali e sviluppare prodotti e soluzioni innovative

• Contribuire a modellare strategie tecnologiche e portafogli di progetto, aiutando a guidare la direzione dell'organizzazione

• Prendere le responsabilità della leadership del progetto o svolgere un ruolo chiave all'interno dei team di progetto, mentre sostenere e sostenere i colleghi junior

• Laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Meccanica, Fisica, o un campo correlato

• 5-10 anni di esperienza in R&D o ingegneria, preferibilmente in apparecchiature o componenti ad alta tensione

• Forte competenza nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di componenti ad alta tensione (l'esperienza con boccole è un vantaggio)

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.

jobs.title: Shift Equipment Maintenance Engineer – Etching 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Join our innovative team as a Shift Maintenance Engineer and play a critical role in the heart of semiconductor production! With a strong focus on etching processes, you'll work with cutting-edge technology to optimize system performance and ensure seamless operations. This is your opportunity to collaborate with experts, contribute to groundbreaking projects, and grow in a dynamic, high-tech environment. If you're passionate about precision and innovation, we want to hear from you!

How you'll make an impact

• Maintain and optimize wet chemical and plasma etch equipment to ensure high availability

• Troubleshoot and repair complex systems in collaboration with OEM partners

• Plan and support preventive maintenance activities to improve tool performance

• Manage spare parts and contribute to equipment upgrades and process improvements

• Collaborate with engineering, R&D, and operations teams to support production goals

• Create and maintain technical documentation and support data tracking in MES systems

• Identify and implement improvements in tools, processes, and operational efficiency

• Ensure compliance with HSE standards and promote a safe working environment

Your background

• Technical vocational training in automation, electronics, or a related field (EFZ or equivalent)

• 2+ years of experience in equipment maintenance in semiconductor or similar industries

• Strong technical knowledge in plasma tools (e.g. AMAT, LAM systems)

• Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics, pneumatics, and vacuum systems

• Ability to work in a team-oriented environment and within shift operations

• Good communication skills in English (German is a plus)

More about us

You will join a dynamic and fast-paced production environment where teamwork, reliability, and technical excellence are key.
Working in a shift-based setup, you will be part of a highly skilled maintenance team supporting critical operations and advanced manufacturing processes.

This role offers hands-on experience with complex technologies and the opportunity to develop your technical skills while contributing directly to production stability and performance.

jobs.title: Semiconductor Shift Maintenance Engineer – Implant 80 – 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Are you passionate about driving innovation and ensuring maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools? As an Implant Maintenance Engineer/Technician, you play a vital role in ensuring the availability, reliability, and continuous improvement of our semiconductor production tool park. Your focus is on the corrective, preventive and predictive maintenance of implant equipment, working cross-functionally to drive safety, productivity, and general tool and workflow optimizations across the production line.

How you'll make an impact

• Ensure maximum uptime of semiconductor production tools through proactive maintenance and troubleshooting of implant equipment

• Drive continuous improvement in equipment performance, applying workplace safety and efficiency practices aligned with 6S methodology

• Collaborate closely with other maintenance, process, and production teams to achieve performance goals and optimize line efficiency

• Participate in tool upgrades and modernization projects to enhance tool capability and reliability

• Maintain accurate and detailed documentation of maintenance activities, equipment status, and system performance

• Support root-cause analysis and problem resolution for technical issues within the team

• Train and mentor colleagues in the areas of implant, safety, and best maintenance practices

• Promote a strong safety culture by ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations, procedures and documentations

Your background

• Hands-on experience in maintenance of semiconductor production tools

• Solid understanding of electronics, mechanics and pneumatics

• Minimum 3 years of experience with ion implanters (such as AMAT or Nissin or Axcelis)

• Familiarity with metrology tools for process control (Semilab WT-2000)

• Additional training or expertise in vacuum systems or related technologies

• Completed technical vocational training (e.g., Automation Technician, Electronics Technician, or similar field)

• Willingness to work in shifts is a must

• Strong team player with problem-solving mentality, organizational skills, and proficiency in English (German is a plus)

More about us

Hitachi Energy offers you interesting tasks in a highly motivated team and an open communication style. Through an individual and practice-oriented induction plan, we will support you to quickly gain professional confidence to be able to work independently with high level of personal responsibility.

descriptionByLocale.it:

Sei appassionato di guidare l'innovazione e garantire il massimo uptime di strumenti di produzione semiconduttore? In qualità di Implant Maintenance Engineer/Technician, si gioca un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire la disponibilità, l'affidabilità e il miglioramento continuo del nostro parco utensili per la produzione di semiconduttori. L'attenzione è rivolta alla corretta, preventiva e predittiva manutenzione delle apparecchiature implantari, lavorando trasversalmente per guidare la sicurezza, la produttività e le ottimizzazioni generali degli utensili e dei flussi di lavoro attraverso la linea di produzione.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Assicurare il massimo uptime degli strumenti di produzione dei semiconduttori attraverso la manutenzione proattiva e la risoluzione dei problemi degli impianti

• Miglioramento continuo delle prestazioni delle attrezzature, applicazione delle pratiche di sicurezza e di efficienza sul posto di lavoro allineate con la metodologia 6S

• Collabora a stretto contatto con altri team di manutenzione, processo e produzione per raggiungere gli obiettivi di performance e ottimizzare l'efficienza della linea

• Partecipare agli aggiornamenti degli strumenti e ai progetti di modernizzazione per migliorare la capacità e l'affidabilità degli strumenti

• Mantenere la documentazione accurata e dettagliata delle attività di manutenzione, lo stato delle attrezzature e le prestazioni del sistema

• Supporta l'analisi delle cause root e la risoluzione dei problemi tecnici all'interno del team

• Collaboratori di formazione e mentore nei settori dell'impianto, della sicurezza e delle migliori pratiche di manutenzione

• Promuovere una forte cultura della sicurezza garantendo il rispetto di tutte le normative, procedure e documenti pertinenti

Il tuo sfondo

• Esperienza pratica nella manutenzione di utensili di produzione semiconduttore

• Solida comprensione dell'elettronica, meccanica e pneumatica

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza con gli impianti ioni (come AMAT o Nissin o Axcelis)

• Familiarità con strumenti di metrologia per il controllo dei processi (Semilab WT-2000)

• Formazione aggiuntiva o competenza in sistemi di vuoto o tecnologie correlate

• Formazione professionale tecnica completa (ad es., Tecnico di automazione, Tecnologia elettronica, o campo simile)

• La volontà di lavorare nei turni è un must

• Forte giocatore di squadra con la mentalità problem-solving, capacità organizzative e competenza in inglese (il tedesco è un plus)

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Hitachi Energy ti offre compiti interessanti in un team altamente motivato e uno stile di comunicazione aperto. Attraverso un piano di induzione individuale e orientato alla pratica, vi supporteremo per guadagnare rapidamente fiducia professionale per poter lavorare in modo indipendente con un alto livello di responsabilità personale.

jobs.title: Laboratory Manager – High Voltage Testing 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
The opportunity

Our local product group Insulation & Components is the technology leader in design and manufacture of high volt-age transformer bushings. All renowned international companies of the electrical industry, active in power genera-tion, transmission and distribution are among our customers. We have a top position in the high voltage trans-former bushing areas worldwide.

In this highly responsible and dynamic role, you will lead our laboratory team at MICAFIL in Zürich-Altstetten (ZH) and ensure that we further strengthen our competitiveness and develop our Swiss branch to meet the global market growth in the field of energy. In this important role, you will continuously drive forward the efficient and innovative processes of our 3 different laboratories together with a strong team. If you have a passion for leadership and high voltage testing, we offer you the stage to bring about real change and actively shape the future of our production processes.

How you'll make an impact

• Ensure compliance with safety and quality standards (IEC/IEEE)

• Analyze & implement efficient production & business processes to increase safety, quality and productivity

• Proven experience in leading and motivating cross-functional teams

• Strong problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision making combined with a strong focus on safety

Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

Il nostro gruppo di prodotti locale Insulation & Components è il leader tecnologico nella progettazione e produzione di boccole per trasformatori ad alta potenza. In questo importante ruolo, continuerai a guidare i processi efficienti e innovativi dei nostri 3 laboratori diversi insieme a un team forte. Se avete una passione per la leadership e i test ad alta tensione, vi offriamo la fase per portare a cambiamenti reali e modellare attivamente il futuro dei nostri processi produttivi.

Come farai ad avere un impatto

• Guidare il team di laboratorio, tra cui la gestione delle risorse e lo sviluppo del team (15 FTE) e agire come punto di contatto per il test HV a Zürich-Altstetten MICAFIL

• Analizzare e implementare processi produttivi e aziendali efficienti per aumentare la sicurezza, la qualità e la produttività

• Assicurare l'alta potenza attraverso procedure di prova ad alta tensione affidabili (AC, DC, impulso, scarico parziale)

• Identificare e integrare nuove tecnologie e migliori pratiche per guidare il processo di miglioramento continuo (CIP) insieme al team e al nostro team di Process Engineering

• Collabora a stretto contatto con la pianificazione, la garanzia della qualità, la logistica, altri dipartimenti di produzione e le parti interessate rilevanti per la progettazione e il miglioramento di processi olistici

• Apprendistato tecnico e qualifiche (Bachelor / Master) nel campo dell'ingegneria elettrica o equivalente

• Diversi anni di esperienza in una posizione di leadership simile (High-Voltage Testing/Insulation Technology/Power Engineering)

• Conoscenza solida nei sistemi di alta tensione, generatori e sistemi di automazione

• Conoscenza solida della gestione magra, Six Sigma e altri metodi di ottimizzazione dei processi

• Esperienza dimostrata nei team leader e motivanti

• Forte capacità di problem solving e un approccio data-driven al processo decisionale combinato con un forte focus sulla sicurezza

• Gestione del tempo eccellente, comunicazione e competenze organizzative

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese

Ulteriori informazioni su di noi

Le nostre pratiche di lavoro flessibili ti aiutano a ottimizzare le prestazioni personali e aziendali creando un ambiente in cui tutti i dipendenti possono sviluppare le loro competenze e crescere.
